Did Jens Soering murder his girlfriend's parents in 1985 — or was she the killer? This docuseries digs into questions that still swirl around the case.

1.title: EN - Till Murder Do Us Part: Soering vs. Haysom [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E01 - A Love Story
1.plot: On April 3, 1985, police discover a horrific blood-soaked crime scene at the Haysom home outside Lynchburg, Virginia, and begin to investigate.

1.plot: While Jens fights extradition, Elizabeth's testimony in court characterizes him as the cold, calculating mastermind behind her parents' deaths.

meta.plot: Unknown histories take center stage as the hitmakers themselves - from ABBA to T-Pain - explore dimensions of pop music you never knew existed.

1.title: EN - This Is Pop [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E01 - Auto-Tune
1.plot: Love it or hate it, Auto-Tune has changed pop music. From Cher's "Believe" to Kanye West's "Love Lockdown," the sound has penetrated the globe and revolutionized music since its invention in 1997. Some say the pitch-correction technology has ruined music, while others have found fame by using the tool creatively. Tracing Auto-Tune's roots to predecessors like the synthesizer, the good, the bad, and the ugly of this game-changing technology is revealed, grounded in a personal account of Auto-Tune's most famous user, T-Pain.

1.title: EN - This Is Pop [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E02 - Hail Britpop!
1.plot: Britpop. The word can elicit an eye roll, an itch to get on the dance floor, or a sudden urge to cry and sing "Wonderwall." In the early ‘90s, when America was hooked on grunge, The Brits retaliated with a return to catchy, witty, and downright fun pop, speaking to their own stories and cultural roots. This musical zeitgeist known as "Britpop" went far behind the headlines of "Oasis vs. Blur" – bands like Elastica, Echobelly, Pulp, Lush, and Suede became international exports with a unique sound.

1.title: EN - This Is Pop [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E03 - Stockholm Syndrome
1.plot: Since 1974, when a little-known group named ABBA won Eurovision's song contest with their track "Waterloo," Sweden has been a global force in exporting pop music. Cassette players and bedroom walls have been filled with the likes of Roxette, Ace of Base, and Robyn, and ‘90s playlists featuring Britney Spears, Backstreet Boys, and *NSYNC would be obsolete without the work of Swedes Denniz Pop and Max Martin.

1.title: EN - This Is Pop [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E04 - The Boyz II Men Effect
1.plot: Before Backstreet Boys, *NSYNC, and 98 Degrees, there was a "boy band" from Philadelphia called Boyz II Men that ruled the charts. With their incredible vocal harmonies and preppy-cool style, Boyz II Men became the "soundtrack to our lives" with hits like "End of The Road", "I'll Make Love To You", "Motown Philly," and "One Sweet Day" – heard at weddings, proms, karaoke bars, and funerals alike. Going back to the band's humble beginnings in Philadelphia, this episode pays homage to the influential R&B group who set the template for ‘90s boy bands.

1.title: EN - This Is Pop [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E05 - When Country Goes Pop
1.plot: It's a tale as old as time – a country song goes "pop" and country music fans protest. From Dolly Parton to Shania Twain to Lil Nas X, the scrutiny around what makes a song "country" has been a raging debate that shows no signs of slowing down.

1.title: EN - This Is Pop [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E06 - The Brill Building in 4 Songs
1.plot: New York City's Brill Building and pop music go together like bread and butter, or in this case, like King n' Goffin, Leiber n' Stoller, or Barry n' Kim. In the 1950s and 60s, songwriters, record producers, and wannabe pop stars flocked to 1619 Broadway in New York with dreams of churning out the next big hit. Full of small rooms with upright pianos, The Brill Building was labelled a "song-factory", but its true spirit grew out of a community that collaborated and challenged each other to achieve greatness.

1.title: EN - This Is Pop [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E07 - What Can A Song Do?
1.plot: For decades, musicians have been using music as their weapon of choice against social injustice, discrimination and marginalization. From Woody Guthrie's "This Land is Your Land" to Kendrick Lamar's "Alright," a song is one of the most powerful ways to transmit a message to a large audience.

1.title: EN - This Is Pop [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E08 - Festival Rising
1.plot: There is no rite of passage quite like the music festival. Millions of people attend them each year and now more than ever they infiltrate our culture from “festival wear” clothing lines to playlists. Taking a journey from ‘60s counterculture to modern-day "selfie" culture, the evolution of the music festival is explored to examine deeper ideas about the importance of collective experiences, and they act as a cultural mirror that reflect interests and ideals.

meta.plot: This docuseries digs into the disappearance of 13-year-old Yara and the disconcerting investigation that shattered the peace of a small Italian town.

1.title: EN - The Yara Gambirasio Case: Beyond Reasonable Doubt [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E01 - Episode 1
1.plot: When Yara stops answering her phone, her parents quickly raise the alarm. Four years later, a suspect is arrested under strange circumstances.

1.title: EN - The Yara Gambirasio Case: Beyond Reasonable Doubt [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E02 - Episode 2
1.plot: The investigation reaches a turning point that everyone hoped to avoid. A testimony triggers theories about revenge against Yara's family.

1.title: EN - The Yara Gambirasio Case: Beyond Reasonable Doubt [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E03 - Episode 3
1.plot: Massimo Bossetti discusses the DNA match that was crucial in Yara's case and reveals secret affairs that destroyed his own family.

1.title: EN - The Yara Gambirasio Case: Beyond Reasonable Doubt [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E04 - Episode 4
1.plot: Cameras are banned from the courtroom as the trial casts doubt on witnesses, including Yara's friends. Some important pieces of evidence are refuted.

1.title: EN - The Yara Gambirasio Case: Beyond Reasonable Doubt [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E05 - Episode 5
1.plot: Bossetti's defense insists on repeating the DNA tests while the prosecutor faces accusations of obstructing the process. The judge announces the verdict.

1.title: FR - King & Conqueror - S01E01 - Invitation
1.plot: Harold of Wessex warns his father, Earl Godwin, of a rival's treachery – but he is ignored.

1.title: FR - King & Conqueror - S01E02 - The Sins of the Father
1.plot: Threatened by those in power in France and England, William and Harold each face grave danger, their families in peril. Refuge in Flanders offers hope for new mother Matilda, while vengeful Lady Emma hounds the Godwins.

1.title: FR - King & Conqueror - S01E03 - Brothers
1.plot: Harold risks returning to Wessex for his wife, while William plots against Henry in France as home truths compromise family ties.

1.title: FR - King & Conqueror - S01E04 - So Be It
1.plot: Crowned heads are endangered as Harold fights for his family's rights and William tracks his royal foe.

1.title: FR - King & Conqueror - S01E05 - The Beast in the Mirror
1.plot: Harold and Edith risk their lives to bargain with William but get a guarded reception. Harold's siblings face hardships trying to secure their family's future.

1.title: FR - King & Conqueror - S01E06 - Damage
1.plot: Ambition drives William and Harold to each seek costly alliances, against the advice of their womenfolk, to enhance their chances of winning the crown.

1.title: FR - King & Conqueror - S01E07 - Cost of War
1.plot: Sacrifices have to be made when Harold strikes against a Viking invader, and William seeks a fleet. Edith fears for the future, while Matilda moves to secure hers.

1.title: FR - King & Conqueror - S01E08 - The Hand of God
1.plot: Harold’s depleted English forces rush to meet William's assault on the south coast. The resulting brutal battle's outcome is unpredictable.

meta.plot: La mort du Roi, en 1066, laisse le trône du royaume d'Angleterre vacant. Une guerre de succession s'engage alors entre Harold de Wessex et Guillaume de Normandie pour s'emparer de la couronne.

1.title: FR - Cougar Town - S01E01 - Dating Scene
1.plot: Pilot - We meet Jules, a woman who at her twenties took on marriage and a baby instead of experiencing the dating scene. Now on her forties, she finds herself as a divorcee and eager to live the dating scene that she missed. With the help of her friend, Laurie, her younger co-worker who wants to show Jules to go out there and have fun. Ellie, her sarcastic, married and content to her average but lovable husband Andy. There's also her family, her ex-husband Bobby and her son Travis, who will test her patience, and her new forty-something divorced neighbour Gray, who doesn't believe that Jules can date again.

1.title: FR - Cougar Town - S01E02 - Into the Great Wide Open
1.plot: Jules tries to party hard like a twentysomething and ends up looking like a total fool, when even her best friend Ellie, told her not to do it. Travis discovers trying to avoid further embarrassment due to his father, Bobby, working at his school, can actually add to it. Jules gets as frustrated as she faces the physical limitations of her age.

1.title: FR - Cougar Town - S01E03 - Don't Do Me Like That
1.plot: Jules family and friends crash the 10th date with her new boyfriend, Josh. Ellie and Laurie help Jules realize that it's ok to be selfish once in a while, when Jules has a disastrous experience in bed with Josh. Meanwhile, Jules left Travis with Bobby, who has to be responsible and deal with his son.

1.title: FR - Cougar Town - S01E04 - I Won't Back Down
1.plot: When Jules inadvertently tells Grayson he's hot and he doesn't reciprocate, she's on a mission to get him to admit she's sexy. With a little help from Laurie and Ellie, Jules uncovers the ultimate burn to put Grayson in his place. Meanwhile, Ellie is feeling like she's lost her looks after the birth of Stan, and Bobby and Travis search for something to bond over.

1.title: FR - Cougar Town - S01E05 - You Wreck Me
1.plot: Jules rues the day when her ex-husband, Bobby, and Grayson become fast friends over a mercy golf lesson that she organized to help boost Bobby's self esteem. Meanwhile, Laurie surprises even herself when she takes on a new client to prove her worth to Jules.

1.title: FR - Cougar Town - S01E06 - A Woman in Love (It's Not Me)
1.plot: When Josh tells Jules he's in love with her, she knows the time has come to break things off with him. Unfortunately for Jules, she's not the best at ending relationships without hurting people's feelings, but thankfully she has the expertise of friends Laurie and Ellie to see her through. Meanwhile, Bobby, Grayson and Andy hit the links with money and pride on the line.

1.title: FR - Cougar Town - S01E07 - Don't Come Around Here No More
1.plot: Jules always seems to be with her friends, her ex or her son. One night when everyone is busy, she reluctantly takes a date with an older man just to get out of the house, so Grayson makes her a wager that she can't spend a whole day by herself.

1.title: FR - Cougar Town - S01E08 - Two Gunslingers
1.plot: Mad because her two best friends don't get along, Jules tries to have fun at her birthday. She finally convinces Ellie and Laurie to go with her on a wild birthday weekend, and they accept. But Jules encounters her nemesis with her flirtatious husband.

1.title: FR - Cougar Town - S01E09 - Here Comes My Girl
1.plot: Jules plan for a romanctic dinner for two backfires for Thanksgiving. Travis shows off his girlfriend Kylie to everyone. Jules gives Travis and Kylie advice on birth control. Bobby and Grayson bond over a common interest.

1.title: FR - Cougar Town - S01E10 - Mystery Man
1.plot: Scott Foley guest stars as Jeff, a very wealthy potential home buyer who is interested in one of Jules overpriced homes. Meanwhile, Ellie with reserves leaves the baby with Andy for a day to prove that she trusts in him.

1.title: FR - Cougar Town - S01E11 - Rhino Skin
1.plot: Despite fearing the meanest and most unrelenting dermatologist in town, Dr. Amy Evans, Jules and Ellie are willing to endure the harsh ridicule and wrath for an appointment with the best in the business. But when Jules learns Dr. Evans is seeing Bobby, she's determined to stand up to her and protect him. Meanwhile, Travis gets a job working for Barb that turns out to be more than he bargained for.

1.title: FR - Cougar Town - S01E12 - Scare Easy
1.plot: When the relationship between Jules and her boyfriend start to heat up, Jules starts to get scared. Meanwhile, Laurie seeks diversion sex with an unsuspecting friend and Andy spills the beans about his big secret.

1.title: FR - Cougar Town - S01E13 - Stop Dragging My Heart Around
1.plot: After her breakup with Jeff, Jules turns to Bobby for some cheering up. But when a bottle of wine leads to a passionate kiss, will they agree it was only a casual meaningless kiss? Meanwhile, Laurie discovers a thing that both Jules and Grayson have in common, while Travis plans with Kylie don't go as planned.

1.title: FR - Cougar Town - S01E14 - All the Wrong Reasons
1.plot: A hot tennis instructor gets between Ellie and Jules, while Laurie turns to Travis for advice, and Andy and Grayson try to cheer up Bobby after a fresh heartbreak over Jules.

1.title: FR - Cougar Town - S01E15 - When a Kid Goes Bad
1.plot: Jules, not wanting to spend Valentine's Day alone, turns to Grayson to keep her company when everyone else makes plans. Meanwhile, Bobby and Jules take different sides when Travis asks to go to a party where they know he will be drinking; Ellie tries to prove she is the alpha dog, not Grayson; and Laurie meets Smith's father.

1.title: FR - Cougar Town - S01E16 - What Are You Doin' in My Life?
1.plot: Laurie needs a co-signer to buy her first condo and finds her less than stellar, absentee mother no help at all. Meanwhile, Bobby is mugged by a woman and Travis comes to Barb's aid after her latest cosmetic surgery procedure.

1.title: FR - Cougar Town - S01E17 - Counting on You
1.plot: Jules is determined to prove to Grayson that women and men can be friends without any sexual undertones. Meanwhile, with Jules' encouragement, Andy buys a motorcycle from Laurie to Ellie's dismay and Travis joins Bobby on a man-trip for some "noodling," only to be mortified by his discovery of what noodling actually is.

1.title: FR - Cougar Town - S01E18 - Turn This Car Around
1.plot: Sara is a confident wine rep who sets her sights on Grayson; but is he strong enough to be her man? Meanwhile, when Ellie tells Jules she can't change past a certain age, Jules is determined to prove her wrong by giving up wine for a month; and Bobby's new dog poses some unwanted competition for Andy.

1.title: FR - Cougar Town - S01E19 - Everything Man
1.plot: Jules and Sara hit it off, but when Grayson is overly attentive to his new girl, Jules warns him to back off before Sara pulls away. Meanwhile, Jules' perfect new bathroom complete with a "talking toilet" becomes the main attraction in her home and Grayson finds inspiration for a new song with a little help from Sara.

1.title: FR - Cougar Town - S01E20 - Wake Up Time
1.plot: Jules is thrilled for the chance to take care of Travis after his first big break-up. But when Jules discovers the truth about the break-up, she comes to an unwelcome realization about herself. Meanwhile, Sara considers whether Jules threatens her relationship with Grayson and turns to Ellie for guidance; and Andy searches for any resemblance between himself and son Stan.

1.title: FR - Cougar Town - S01E21 - Letting You Go
1.plot: Jules has mixed feelings when Travis gets accepted to two of his choice colleges. Now he must decide between schools in California or one just 20 minutes from home. As Jules struggles with the thought of Travis moving away, Grayson is there for her. Meanwhile, Laurie considers her feelings for Smith when he returns from law school, and Andy longs for the freedom to do whatever he wants around the house, free of Ellie's rules.

1.title: FR - Cougar Town - S01E22 - Feel a Whole Lot Better
1.plot: Jules and Grayson consider the notion of FWB, friends with benefits. Meanwhile Andy hires a nanny for Ellie, and Travis benefits from Bobby's unconventional plans to make some extra cash

1.title: FR - Cougar Town - S01E23 - Breakdown
1.plot: Despite Grayson's warning, a curious Jules reads the speech without permission and is left crushed when she finds she's not been acknowledged. Meanwhile, Ellie uncharacteristically does something nice for Laurie, and Bobby tries to restrain himself from embarrassing Travis on his big day.

1.title: FR - Cougar Town - S01E24 - Finding Out
1.plot: Jules and Grayson hatch an elaborate plan to break the news to Bobby that they're officially dating, and Travis sees the wrath of a truly angry woman for the first time when he forgets his momentous seven-month anniversary with Kylie.

2.title: FR - Cougar Town - S02E01 - All Mixed Up
2.plot: Bobby struggles with the reality of Jules being in a relationship with Grayson. Jules has issues with her new psychiatrist when she discovers the truth behind her methods.

2.title: FR - Cougar Town - S02E02 - Let Yourself Go
2.plot: Jules has difficulty coping when Travis gets ready to leave for college; Andy forms an elaborate plan to deceive Ellie.

2.title: FR - Cougar Town - S02E03 - Makin' Some Noise
2.plot: As Jules adjusts to living on her own, Grayson unwillingly becomes the new object of her constant attention; Travis turns to Bobby for advice on how to redefine himself at college; and Ellie is determined not to be friends with her new nanny.

2.title: FR - Cougar Town - S02E04 - The Damage You've Done
2.plot: Grayson decides that it's the right time to tell Jules about what had happened between Laurie and himself. After Jules knows the truth she tries to project her anger at someone, but cannot decide at who. While Laurie professes hel love for Smith, and Bobby gets obsessed with watching a street performer swallow a sword, and Andy gets Travis to doubt Kylie.

2.title: FR - Cougar Town - S02E05 - Keeping Me Alive
2.plot: Jules schemes to continue giving Bobby money when he stops taking alimony payments. Ellie ticks off the gang by being arrogant about her intelligence.

2.title: FR - Cougar Town - S02E06 - You Don't Know How It Feels
2.plot: Jules isn't happy when her father pays a visit. Travis gets a surprise at Halloween, and Bobby campaigns to be Stan's guardian should something happen to Ellie and Andy.

2.title: FR - Cougar Town - S02E07 - Fooled Again (I Don't Like It)
2.plot: It's Jules' 42nd birthday and that can only mean one thing: gift contest! Each year, Jules holds a contest to determine who gives her the best gifts, which Ellie always wins. This year, Laurie teams up with Grayson in an attempt to overthrow her. As Jules contemplates what to do for her birthday, Andy suggests a night of dancing. Meanwhile, Travis introduces Bobby to a Netti Pot, but not without its consequences.

2.title: FR - Cougar Town - S02E08 - Little Girl Blues
2.plot: Travis brings home his new girlfriend, Kirsten, a grad-student, to meet Jules. Jules feels instantly threatened when Ellie points out that, moving forward, any girl Travis brings home could be her future daughter-in-law. Meanwhile, Grayson's house has become the new place for the gang to hang out, which he hates, and Travis turns to Bobby for advice.

2.title: FR - Cougar Town - S02E09 - When the Time Comes
2.plot: Jules says "I love you" to Grayson for the first time, but when Grayson doesn't reciprocate with the words she wants to hear, she's determined to host a "romantic" Thanksgiving in order force the moment on of him. Meanwhile, Ellie and Laurie team up to knock the optimism out of Andy, and Bobby is upset when the gang confesses that sometimes they can't understand what he's saying.

2.title: FR - Cougar Town - S02E10 - The Same Old You
2.plot: Jules wants to help Bobby gain his confidence back and thinks fixing up his boat and getting it back in the water will do the trick.

2.title: FR - Cougar Town - S02E11 - No Reason to Cry
2.plot:
When Grayson doesn't share Jules' sadness on a series of unfortunate but accidental events, she questions whether they're meant to be together.

Meanwhile, Travis' new girlfriend throws Bobby off his golf game, and Ellie gets upset with Andy when he uses their joke on Laurie.

2.title: FR - Cougar Town - S02E12 - A Thing About You
2.plot: Although Laurie may be the worst houseguest ever, Jules is there for her when she needs a place to stay; Laurie helps Jules to realize she doesn't need to change for others; and when Bobby is jealous that Travis has gone to Grayson for advice, Grayson comes through for his buddy.

2.title: FR - Cougar Town - S02E13 - Lost Children
2.plot: Jules comes up with a new game for the crew; Ellie complains about doing what Jules wants to do; Andy is mad at Grayson; Bobby introduces his new friend to the group.

2.title: FR - Cougar Town - S02E14 - Cry to Me
2.plot: Jules wishes Grayson would share his feelings with her; Ellie insists she doesn't want to do anything for Valentine's Day; Andy makes a date with Bobby; Travis asks Laurie for help with his gift for Kirsten.

2.title: FR - Cougar Town - S02E15 - Walls
2.plot: Once again Jules chooses to get too involved in Travis' life.

2.title: FR - Cougar Town - S02E16 - Baby’s a Rock ‘N’ Roller
2.plot: Ellie tricks Jules into watching Baby Stan on her own for a day, but Jules is determined to prove how easy it is... especially when she's roped in Grayson to help. Meanwhile, Bobby's given the chance to play golf for free in order to train for his upcoming tournament, as long as he tees off before 6:00 a.m., and Andy volunteers to be Laurie's wingman as she puts herself back out there after her split with Smith.

2.title: FR - Cougar Town - S02E17 - You're Gonna Get It
2.plot: Travis joins his father and Andy at a professional golf tournament; Jules faces her fear of public humiliation; Ellie and Grayson are impressed by Laurie in a trivia game.

2.title: FR - Cougar Town - S02E18 - Lonesome Sundown
2.plot: Jules tries to not interfere when Travis contemplates a big decision; the gang tries stop taking advantage of each other.

2.title: FR - Cougar Town - S02E19 - Damaged By Love
2.plot: When Travis suffers his first truly broken heart, Jules and Bobby are at a loss as to how to help him. Meanwhile, Grayson stands up to Jules when she tries to tell him what to do, and Ellie turns to Laurie for support when Andy's overly flirty sister-in-law, comes to visit.

2.title: FR - Cougar Town - S02E20 - Free Fallin'
2.plot: As Travis continues on a downward spiral from his breakup with Kirsten, Jules decides it's time to give him some tough love.

2.title: FR - Cougar Town - S02E21 - Something Good Coming (1)
2.plot: When Travis abruptly moves to Hawaii, the gang go after him and decide to spend their vacation there too. As Jules struggles with Travis' choice, Grayson tells her he's keen on having kids. Meanwhile, Bobby acts as Ellie and Andy's vacation surrogate, and Laurie hatches a plan to lure Travis back home.

2.title: FR - Cougar Town - S02E22 - Something Good Coming (2)
2.plot: When Travis abruptly moves to Hawaii, the gang go after him and decide to spend their vacation there too. As Jules struggles with Travis' choice, Grayson tells her he's keen on having kids. Meanwhile, Bobby acts as Ellie and Andy's vacation surrogate, and Laurie hatches a plan to lure Travis back home.

3.title: FR - Cougar Town - S03E01 - Ain't Love Strange
3.plot: Jules is miffed when Grayson (who has an ulterior motive) calls her "predictable"; Ellie frets that little Stan is turning into a "devil child," or even worse, could grow up to be like Laurie; and Travis likes his new off campus housing, until Bobby tries to convince him to take dog Travis in.

3.title: FR - Cougar Town - S03E02 - A Mind With a Heart of Its Own
3.plot: Jules ends up asking both Ellie and Laurie to be her "co-maids" of honor because she can't stand to hurt anyone's feelings; and Grayson tries to ask Chick for Jules' hand in marriage formally, but Chick decides to have a little fun in the process.

3.title: FR - Cougar Town - S03E03 - Lover's Touch
3.plot: There is no time for romance when you're planning a wedding, and Jules is in full "AWATT" mode (All Wedding All the Time), until Travis is in an accident and rushed to the hospital. Meanwhile Grayson is feeling neglected by Jules, so the guys try to cheer him up by inventing a new game called "D-Ball," and things get dangerous when Laurie and Ellie want to play.

3.title: FR - Cougar Town - S03E04 - Full Moon Fever
3.plot: One look is all it takes for Bobby to fall for Travis' photography professor, but Travis refuses to introduce them; Laurie falls for a guy she's never met when she begins a romance, via twitter, with a soldier in Iraq; and Jules and Andy prepare to go to war against an unruly gang of kids on bikes who are terrorizing the cul-de-sac.

3.title: FR - Cougar Town - S03E05 - A One Story Town
3.plot: Jules and the gang decide Bobby needs some help romancing Angie so they launch "operation kiss-the-girl." Meanwhile, other former "Scrubs" cast turn up, as Ted and the Peons pass through on their way to audition at Disney World.

3.title: FR - Cougar Town - S03E06 - Something Big
3.plot: Just as Jules is trying to work through Grayson's "baggage" from his wild single days, a chance encounter with a former fling, Holly, ends with him learning that he's the father of a one-year-old baby girl he never knew he had.

3.title: FR - Cougar Town - S03E07 - You Can Still Change Your Mind
3.plot: Travis wants to take Jules and Grayson's wedding pictures, but Jules, who wants everything to be perfect for her second wedding, isn't so sure; meanwhile Bobby wants to get serious with Angie, but does she feel the same way?

3.title: FR - Cougar Town - S03E08 - Ways to Be Wicked
3.plot: Ellie cautions the cul-de-sac crew that her visiting mother is not as nice as she seems. Meanwhile, Grayson offers to help Laurie start a cake business; and Bobby and Chick become accomplices in a college prank pulled by Travis and his friends to steal a cougar statue.

3.title: FR - Cougar Town - S03E09 - Money Becomes King
3.plot: Jules and Grayson can't see eye to eye when it comes to joining their finances, but they're both going to have to make some sacrifices if they actually want to get married -- and that is not going to be easy. Meanwhile, Laurie's Krazy Kakes business is doing surprisingly well, and Travis convinces her to make some grown up decisions of her own.

3.title: FR - Cougar Town - S03E10 - Southern Accents
3.plot: Jules has a hard time accepting that Holly is part of her life, a situation that does not improve after she finds out that Holly and Travis made out; Andy wants to run for mayor so he can change the town rules against weddings on the beach (something Jules has her heart set on), but Ellie won't let him; and Laurie tries to convince Bobby he's just socially inept, not prejudiced, after he blurts out some awkward comments at the cake shop.

3.title: FR - Cougar Town - S03E11 - Down South
3.plot: Jules has a hurricane party at her house when a storm blows into town; Travis decides to make a play for Laurie.

3.title: FR - Cougar Town - S03E12 - Square One
3.plot: After Grayson's house sustains hurricane damage, he moves in with Jules; Laurie and Ellie ask Travis to help determine which of them is sexier; Bobby and Jules compete in a ``white shirt challenge.''

3.title: FR - Cougar Town - S03E13 - It'll All Work Out
3.plot: Jules plans a spring Thanksgiving after realizing the gang didn't celebrate the holiday together; Ellie's parenting skills are called into question when Stan gets a hold of Big Carl; Grayson helps Andy prepare for an annual pizza toss.

3.title: FR - Cougar Town - S03E14 - My Life (1)
3.plot: When Grayson complains that he's living the movie "Groundhog Day" because the gang shows up at the same time every day at Jules' house, Jules asks for a "Groundhog Day"-themed bachelorette party so that Ellie and Laurie can explain the movie to her. Then, fed up with the lack of privacy, Grayson convinces Jules to elope to Napa . . . but the cul de sac crew happily tags along.

3.title: FR - Cougar Town - S03E15 - Your World (2)
3.plot: When Grayson complains that he's living the movie "Groundhog Day" because the gang shows up at the same time every day at Jules' house, Jules asks for a "Groundhog Day"-themed bachelorette party so that Ellie and Laurie can explain the movie to her. Then, fed up with the lack of privacy, Grayson convinces Jules to elope to Napa . . . but the cul de sac crew happily tags along

4.title: FR - Cougar Town - S04E01 - Blue Sunday
4.plot: It's the first week of marriage for Grayson and Jules, but when Grayson doesn't know the rules, he soon becomes Jules' "coffee and wine bitch." After Travis' 21st birthday, Bobby tries to make up for lost time by teaching him lessons about being a man. And Ellie and Laurie try to pull Jules out of her depression when Grayson refuses to apologize for what he did in her dream.

4.title: FR - Cougar Town - S04E02 - I Need to Know
4.plot: Jules releases Travis from mandatory family night, but when he stays away too long, she becomes crazed. Ellie discovers she can get Andy to do anything she wants by training him like a dog. And the guys grow mustaches to look cool like Tom Selleck.

4.title: FR - Cougar Town - S04E03 - Between Two Worlds
4.plot: Jules begins to worry that her marriage to Grayson lacks passion. But when she enlists Ellie to start a verbal firestorm, things quickly get too heated. Laurie helps Travis find his superpower. And Bobby tries to shake things up by taking on a 'cooler' persona.

4.title: FR - Cougar Town - S04E04 - I Should Have Known It
4.plot: When Tom gets a new girlfriend, the girls decide to investigate. Bobby goes on a fake date with Ellie to improve his table manners. And after getting fed up with the girls' rules, Andy and Grayson rebel.

4.title: FR - Cougar Town - S04E05 - Runnin' Down a Dream
4.plot: Jules decides that her heart is no longer in the real estate business. Meanwhile, Bobby discovers his dream job selling premade burgers from a truck.

4.title: FR - Cougar Town - S04E06 - Restless
4.plot: Jules has trouble sleeping, and it seems like nothing can help her relax. Grayson's face gets mangled in a roller hockey game. And Ellie goes into hiding after Andy decides to redeem his stash of sex coupons on Valentine’s Day.

4.title: FR - Cougar Town - S04E07 - Flirting With Time
4.plot: When buyers show interest in Grayson's house, the crew is quick to judge their potential new neighbors. They also become nostalgic about when redneck Bobby and Jules first moved into the neighborhood. Meanwhile, Wade returns home from Afghanistan early, but Laurie's initial excitement quickly turns to fear when he becomes too clingy.

4.title: FR - Cougar Town - S04E08 - You and I Will Meet Again
4.plot: Laurie and Wade decide to move in together, but breaking the news to Travis doesn't go as planned. Tom becomes Jules' personal cheerleader after losing his "new guy" status. And Jules and Grayson have a naked day that turns out to be anything but sexy.

4.title: FR - Cougar Town - S04E09 - Make It Better
4.plot: Jules' dad Chick spends some time at her house while recovering from an injury. During his stay, Jules experiences extreme stomach pain, but she's too stubborn to let her dad know. And Bobby and Grayson attempt to teach Travis how to be a "playa."

4.title: FR - Cougar Town - S04E10 - You Tell Me
4.plot: Confused by her mixed feelings for Travis, Laurie resorts to destroying things. But when her anger gets out of control, newly appointed mayor Andy has to step in. Jules starts hanging out with her therapist after discovering that her friends have been keeping secrets. And Bobby has a fling with the girl of his dreams while enjoying a vacation at Target.

4.title: FR - Cougar Town - S04E11 - Saving Grace
4.plot: Travis and Andy take a backseat to Bobby's new tomboy friend, Riggs. Grayson sparks a religious debate when he sighs during Jules' family prayer. And the Cul-De-Sac Crew form a dodgeball league, but Andy's attention toward another girl leads to a brawl with a group of pre-teens.

4.title: FR - Cougar Town - S04E12 - This Old Town
4.plot: An elderly couple, Ann and Norman McCormack, buy Grayson's old house after Jules promises them that they will all spend time together. Forced to hang out with the McCormacks, Ellie, Jules and Grayson soon discover that there are many perks to being old. Meanwhile, when another one of Bobby's get-rich-quick schemes doesn't pan out, he tries to switch up his luck by renaming his boat. And Travis searches for the perfect partner to win a high-stakes penny can game.

4.title: FR - Cougar Town - S04E13 - The Criminal Kind
4.plot: Inspired by "The Breakfast Club," the Cul-De-Sac Crew offers insight into their innermost thoughts through voice-overs. Grayson is crushed after discovering some harsh reviews on Yelp. And Jules goes to extremes to prove she's not a goody-two-shoes, ultimately landing herself in grocery store jail.

4.title: FR - Cougar Town - S04E14 - Don't Fade On Me
4.plot: Chick comes to housesit while the gang goes on vacation. But when Jules discovers that her father hasn't been to the doctor in years, she insists on taking him. Laurie and Travis go on their first date as boyfriend and girlfriend. And Bobby is crushed to discover that Dog Travis is just using him for food.

4.title: FR - Cougar Town - S04E15 - Have Love Will Travel
4.plot: After discovering that Chick has health issues, the gang decides to take him to Hollywood. Once there, they'll stop at nothing to arrange for him to spend an evening with one his favorite stars, Tippi Hedren. Meanwhile, Laurie and Travis try carefully to set up the perfect first kiss. And Andy is upset to discover that no one recognizes him as Latino.

5.title: FR - Cougar Town - S05E01 - All or Nothin'
5.plot: The Cul de Sac Crew feels weird about Laurie and Travis dating, but Jules is determined to play it cool. Bobby and Andy make it big when Penny Can goes global. But when Bobby starts throwing around money, Grayson confronts him about years of unpaid bar tabs. Meanwhile, Andy struggles to get Stan to sleep after a slasher movie.

5.title: FR - Cougar Town - S05E02 - Like a Diamond
5.plot: Jules and Grayson receive a wedding invitation from a couple they barely know and on a date that conflicts with Grayson's roller-hockey finals. Despite Grayson's important plans, Jules simply cannot say no. Meanwhile, Bobby finds out that Dog Travis has puppies, and the crew discovers that Tom has created a model of the neighborhood with eerily lifelike dolls of everyone.

5.title: FR - Cougar Town - S05E03 - Depending on You
5.plot: Jules and Grayson receive a wedding invitation but have conflicting plans; Tom has made a model of the neighborhood with eerily lifelike dolls.

5.title: FR - Cougar Town - S05E04 - The Trip to Pirates Cove
5.plot: The town of Gulf Haven is transformed into a pirate's cove for Buccaneer Week. Determined to step up his mayoral duties, Andy pleads with Ellie to appeal to tourists by bringing out her alter ego, Charming Ellie. Enamored by this new, lovable version of her best friend, Jules cannot get enough of "Chellie." Meanwhile, Laurie starts baking "naughty cakes" to increase sales.

5.title: FR - Cougar Town - S05E05 - Hard on Me
5.plot: Andy organizes a Gulf Haven 5k in an effort to save his reputation as Mayor after an embarrassing article comes out in the local paper. Jules uses the race to help her dad Chick get out of the house and relive his coaching days. But the crew struggles to get through his intense workouts. Meanwhile, Grayson fulfills his dream of being cast in a commercial; however, he's in for a big surprise when he receives his role.

5.title: FR - Cougar Town - S05E06 - Learning to Fly
5.plot: Laurie teaches Jules the rules of karma after Jules lies to customers at the annual cul-de-sac yard sale. Andy uses some of his new yard sale purchases to test Ellie after they make a bet that she can't refrain from being snarky for one day. Meanwhile, Bobby must overcome his fear of rollercoasters to fulfill his grandfather's dying wish.

5.title: FR - Cougar Town - S05E07 - Time to Move On
5.plot: With Travis graduating college in a few months, Jules starts to worry about his job prospects with an art degree. Laurie and Ellie pose as a lesbian couple in a desperate effort to get Stan into a fancy new school. Meanwhile, Andy insists on making a cat video with the guys for Bro-day.

5.title: FR - Cougar Town - S05E08 - Mystery of Love
5.plot: After Travis and Laurie have Jules and Grayson over for a sophisticated brunch, Jules attempts to prove that she and Grayson are the better couple. Andy plans a beach day for Stan so he will be considered a fun dad. Meanwhile, Tom helps Ellie finish a teen novel she started writing years ago.

5.title: FR - Cougar Town - S05E09 - Too Much Ain't Enough
5.plot: After Jules receives a large commission check, she enlists Andy to be her business partner in a get-rich-quick scheme. Meanwhile, Grayson tries to seem cool to Travis's new hipster friends, and Bobby struggles to feel comfortable with his new bag.

5.title: FR - Cougar Town - S05E10 - Too Good To Be True
5.plot: Travis starts an open mic night at Coffee Bucks, but things go awry when Andy tries to do stand-up comedy. Tom's daughter Haylee comes to visit, and Grayson and Jules decide to play along when they discover that Tom's been lying to Haylee in order to make himself sound cool.

5.title: FR - Cougar Town - S05E11 - Refugee
5.plot: When Bobby's boat goes missing, Jules and Bobby step into their old crime fighting personas, "Blacktop" and "Gumshoe", in order to solve the mystery. Meanwhile, Grayson helps Andy win over his new supervisor by teaching him "the neg," and Laurie and Travis attempt to decorate her apartment together.

5.title: FR - Cougar Town - S05E12 - Love is a Long Road
5.plot: As Chick deals with the fallout from his first Alzheimers symptoms, Jules convinces him to look at houses nearby.  Without meaning to, Grayson introduces the idea of Chick moving in with them, a suggestion he quickly regrets.  All the while, the Cul de Sac Crew excitedly prepares for Travis's college graduation which kicks off, among other things, a rivalry between Ellie and Laurie for who is #1 on Jules' most-important-friend list.

5.title: FR - Cougar Town - S05E13 - We Stand a Chance
5.plot: After winning Cul de Sac Crew Trivia, Tom gets to pick the location of the next group vacation. The gang is less than thrilled, however, when Tom opts for a stay-cation. Meanwhile, Jules fakes being healthy at her annual physical exam and gets some shocking results. And Bobby accidentally signs Grayson and himself up for a breakdancing competition.

6.title: FR - Cougar Town - S06E01 - American Dream Plan B
6.plot: Jules agrees to stop drinking wine during Laurie's pregnancy, but the rest of the gang doesn't agree, so Tom opens up his garage as a speakeasy. Meanwhile, Grayson prepares Travis for fatherhood with the help of a baby pig.

6.title: FR - Cougar Town - S06E02 - Full Grown Boy
6.plot: Jules is overprotective when Chick wants to go to his Civil War reenactment. Bobby considers a job opportunity in another state. Travis hates Laurie's choices for baby names and needs Ellie to destroy them.

6.title: FR - Cougar Town - S06E03 - To Find a Friend
6.plot: When Grayson helps Andy with his tryouts for a new best friend, Jules and Ellie step in to run the bar. But they soon find it's harder than they thought. And Travis and Laurie spend their first weekend alone with Baby Bobby.

6.title: FR - Cougar Town - S06E04 - Waiting for Tonight
6.plot: Grayson makes a reservation at the hottest restaurant in town, and he and Jules are determined to make it despite constant obstacles. Andy rents a special costume for Stan's birthday, but he has trouble getting it off. And Ellie starts ghost tweeting for Laurie, eventually getting lost in her new character.

6.title: FR - Cougar Town - S06E05 - Even the Losers
6.plot: Jules sees that Travis is struggling financially, so she lends him money that he uses to start a new business. Ellie takes Andy on a revenge mission after he loses his mayorship. And Grayson fills in as a music teacher at Stan's school.

6.title: FR - Cougar Town - S06E06 - The Wrong Thing To Do
6.plot: Seeing that Andy is unprepared for his upcoming job interviews, Jules agrees to coach him through it. Ellie needs a place to escape since Andy is home all the time, so she goes to Bobby's boat, only to find that Grayson beat her to it. Meanwhile, Travis and Laurie encourage Tom to date ... with disastrous results.

6.title: FR - Cougar Town - S06E07 - The Wild One, Forever
6.plot: After a hurricane floods the gym of a local high school, Jules volunteers Gray's Pub as a venue for their prom, with the gang ready to serve as chaperones. Jules and Laurie try to have an amazing night, but Laurie isn't feeling it. Andy and Ellie try to stop a gang of bullies. And Travis and Grayson help their high school counterparts win a girl.

6.title: FR - Cougar Town - S06E08 - This One's For Me
6.plot: When Jules finds a bag of unusual items Grayson's been hiding, she goes on a mission to learn his secret. Andy talks Travis into using a baby gift for himself and Ellie can't stand that Laurie is treating Baby Bobby like an accessory.

6.title: FR - Cougar Town - S06E09 - Two Men Talking
6.plot: Jules tries to set her father up with Grayson as a best friend; a cool mom group.

6.title: FR - Cougar Town - S06E10 - Yer So Bad
6.plot: Jules' dinner guests aren't exactly who she expected; staking out a cupcake thief; Tom's patient.

6.title: FR - Cougar Town - S06E11 - Climb That Hill
6.plot: Jules tries to read a book for the first time; Grayson tries to remember what his friends say.

6.title: FR - Cougar Town - S06E12 - A Two Story Town
6.plot: Everyone pitches in to help Tom with his new crush with disastrous results.

6.title: FR - Cougar Town - S06E13 - Mary Jane's Last Dance
6.plot: Grayson tries to prevent Jules from running her birthday; everyone experiences major life changes.

meta.plot: Jules Cobb, âgée de 40 ans, est un agent immobilier fraîchement divorcée vivant avec son fils Travis, âgé de 17 ans, dans l'aire urbaine de Tampa Bay, dans la ville de Gulfhaven en Floride surnommée « Cougar Town » parce que son équipe de football américain du lycée se nomme les « Cougars », non loin de son ex-mari Bobby, un peu tête en l'air et qui éprouve toujours des sentiments pour elle. Essayant de faire face aux problèmes du quotidien, elle décide de se remettre à la « chasse aux hommes » avec l'aide de ses meilleures amies : Ellie, mère de famille mariée dans la quarantaine également, et Laurie, sa jeune employée écervelée de 28 ans…

1.title: FR - Ben Onun Annesiyim - S01E01 - 1. Bölüm
1.plot: Ayşe spent years in prison, accused of murdering her husband. Upon her release, her sole purpose is to reunite with her daughter, Zeynep, who was taken from her years ago. However, her daughter has now been adopted by another man, and she doesn't know who Ayşe is. For Ayşe, the only way to achieve this reunion is to win the trust, and even the heart, of Kemal, the man who adopted her daughter. Her biggest obstacle in this process is her former mother-in-law, İlter, who blames Ayşe for her son's death and seeks revenge.

1.title: FR - Ben Onun Annesiyim - S01E02 - Episode 2
FR - Ben Onun Annesiyim - S01E03 - Episode 3
FR - Ben Onun Annesiyim - S01E04 - Episode 4
FR -The Island - S01E01 - Episode 1
1.plot: PC Kat Crichton confronts her past when assigned to a murder case on the Isle of Harris.

1.title: FR -The Island - S01E02 - Episode 2
1.plot: Kat fights to gather evidence against Sir Douglas, but new revelations change everything.

1.title: FR -The Island - S01E03 - Episode 3
1.plot: The case is coming to a close, but Kat still believes the Macleans are hiding something.

1.title: FR -The Island - S01E04 - Episode 4
1.plot: With her career hanging in the balance, it's Kat's last chance to catch Mary's killer.

meta.plot: Kat Crichton, jeune agente de liaison familiale, est chargée d'enquêter sur le meurtre brutal de l'épouse d'un riche magnat local dans une luxueuse villa isolée sur une île. L'enquête se déroule sur l'île de Lewis et Harris, d'où Kat a mystérieusement fui dix ans auparavant.

1.title: FR - Veliaht [VOSTFR] - S01E01 - Episode 1
1.plot: Zülfikar Karslı, the spiritual father of the bus terminal, is struggling with health problems. For some time, he has managed to brush off the community’s pressure for his son Zafer to return and take charge. But with Yahya—who has moved to Esenler to avenge his murdered father—now in the picture, Zülfikar has no choice but to find an heir other than his ailing son Zafer. The lives of everyone will be turned upside down when the path of Timur, a street repairman struggling to care for his mother and sister alone, crosses with that of the Karslı family.

1.title: FR - Veliaht [VOSTFR] - S01E02 - Episode 2
1.plot: Brought to the mansion as the heir, Timur struggles to make sense of what has happened to him. The family members, however, react strongly to the arrival of this man they do not know and to his being chosen as the heir. Reyhan, for her part, is uneasy about having to play the role of husband and wife with a stranger in public. Unaware of all that is unfolding, Zafer’s inevitable encounter with the stranger in the house threatens to unleash chaos within the Karslı family.

1.title: FR - Veliaht [VOSTFR] - S01E03 - Episode 3
1.plot: The news of Timur’s arrival hits Esenler Bus Terminal like a bomb. Everyone is curious about Zafer Karslı, the heir who has resurfaced after many years. Yahya returns to the Karslı mansion after years away, unsettling the family with his unique demeanor and testing Zülfikar over the money he once stole. When he finally finds himself alone with Derya, the door to their past is slightly opened again. Meanwhile, a new friendship begins to blossom between Cennet and Gülşah. Reyhan and Timur are forced to play the roles of husband and wife in public. At the wedding the Karslı family and Timur must attend, surprises await them all. But Timur’s past will not let him go so easily.

1.title: FR - Veliaht [VOSTFR] - S01E04 - Episode 4
1.plot: Timur goes after the stolen money and makes a plan to recover it. Learning of her father’s illness, Derya tries to gather general power of attorney from her siblings in order to take control. The sudden arrival of Yahya’s unruly brother Selim comes as a major surprise to the entire Karslı family. The anniversary of their mother Gönül’s death deeply affects everyone in the Karslı mansion. But when Zülfikar learns that Derya is trying to overthrow him, turmoil erupts in the household.

1.title: FR - Veliaht [VOSTFR] - S01E05 - Episode 5
1.plot: After Zülfikar suffers a heart attack and is rushed to the hospital, the whole family is filled with worry. Timur confronts Arnavut Saim and is shaken to the core by the shocking truths he uncovers. The shadows of the past now loom not only over the Karslı family but also over Timur himself. Although Timur and Reyhan both know that being together is impossible, they find themselves drawn to each other more with each passing day. When Zülfikar and Timur return to Esenler Bus Terminal as though they were father and son, they are met with a grave danger awaiting them.

1.title: FR - Veliaht [VOSTFR] - S01E06 - Episode 6
1.plot: Timur and Zülfikar Karslı's relationship takes on a new dimension after Timur's shooting. This situation also impacts Timur's life at the Karslı mansion. Reyhan, having found Timur so late, faces the possibility of losing him. While the Esenler family is held accountable for Timur's shooting, Yahya tries to clean up after Selim's schemes, which he had undertaken without his knowledge. Timur eats his mother's food, hears her voice, and inhales her scent. He realizes that past secrets could be not only his salvation, but also Reyhan's. Now he's ready to fight to end their captivity.

1.title: FR - Veliaht [VOSTFR] - S01E07 - Episode 7
1.plot: Yahya goes after his father’s prayer beads and, together with Selim, visits Arnavut Saim. Meanwhile, torn between his two identities, Timur and Zafer, Timur begins to grow closer to Reyhan at the bus terminal. The partnership between Doğu Kapı and Yahya is made official, and contracts are signed. To celebrate, Yahya suggests a gathering and even has a surprise planned for Derya. When Cennet spots a photo of Timur at Gülşah’s house, the veil of secrets begins to lift. At the same time, Yahya and Hemşinli Davut start conducting secret business behind everyone’s backs, but things don’t unfold as they planned. In the end, Yahya and Timur are forced into a journey together, one where they come face-to-face and quietly test each other’s intentions.

1.title: FR - Veliaht [VOSTFR] - S01E08 - Episode 8
1.plot: After witnessing Yahya’s feverish ramblings, Timur begins to question the past more deeply than ever. The tension between them escalates as both men make strategic moves over the bus hijacking incident. Arnavut Saim finally comes face to face with Zülfikar,the man he holds responsible for the death of the woman he loved years ago, and looks him straight in the eye. Meanwhile, Vezir is forced to confront the possibility that the secrets he has long kept hidden may soon come to light. As Yahya grows closer to Büşra to advance his plans, Derya witnesses their intimacy and is left shaken. At the same time, Timur and Reyhan’s inability to resist their feelings for each other leads them straight into trouble.

1.title: FR - Veliaht [VOSTFR] - S01E09 - Episode 9
1.plot: Timur faces a major confrontation with the Vizier and tries to protect both himself and Reyhan. Gülşah, having learned that her brother is alive, is torn between truth and lies, and it's only a matter of time before Timur's identity is revealed. Yahya and Hemşinli Davut devise a plan to launch an operation to prevent Zülfikar from securing his own safe haven. While Gönül's birthday is celebrated among the siblings, Derya is confronted with her mother's deepest secret, a secret she's never known. Reyhan faces grave danger during her transfer to Doğa's open prison, while a huge surprise awaits Timur in Esenler.

1.title: FR - Veliaht [VOSTFR] - S01E10 - Episode 10
FR - Veliaht [VOSTFR] - S01E11 - Episode 11
FR - Veliaht [VOSTFR] - S01E12 - Episode 12
FR - Veliaht [VOSTFR] - S01E13 - Episode 13
FR - Aşk ve Gözyaşı [VOSTFR] - S01E01 - Episode 1
1.plot: The three-year marriage between Meyra, the daughter of one of the country's most powerful families, and Selim, a successful lawyer from a modest background, appears enviable from the outside. However, behind this splendor, unshared feelings, unspoken resentments, and delayed confrontations accumulate. The growing silence has turned two people who once looked to each other with love, devotion, and hope into strangers. The cracks in Meyra and Selim's relationship become unmaskable, while the emotional rift between them and the pressures within their family deepen this estrangement. While Meyra chooses to turn a blind eye to these problems, Selim feels he can no longer bear it and searches for a way out, even if it means burning his boat. But at this point, unexpected news disrupts the balance of their relationship and their lives. Fate will not only force them to remain together, but also to confront their pasts and each other honestly.

1.title: FR - Aşk ve Gözyaşı [VOSTFR] - S01E02 - Episode 2
1.plot: Learning that Meyra has three months to live is a devastating turning point for Selim, who is determined to get a divorce. Although he thinks that this marriage can no longer be sustained, knowing that the woman he once loved is walking towards death forces him to rethink this decision. Meyra, on the other hand, tries to accept this news with great composure. Despite experiencing inner turmoil, she chooses to keep her feelings bottled up and her illness a secret from both her family and those around her. However, years of conflict with her family, especially tensions with her mother, make this process even more tiring and lonely. As time runs out, Meyra begins to face her fear of being alone, while Selim begins to question what it means to stay. The couple, who are struggling under the pressure of Meyra's time shortage and Selim's feeling trapped, will experience new confrontations in the face of this surprise visitor from the past and unexpected events.

1.title: FR - Aşk ve Gözyaşı [VOSTFR] - S01E03 - Episode 3
1.plot: Selim is deeply unsettled by Meyra's illness and doesn't want to leave her alone. Although he thought his feelings for Meyra had faded, the news of her illness brought some feelings back to light, and he decides to plan a special anniversary event. However, Ercan, unable to bear the fact that Meyra and Selim's relationship has seemingly recovered, thwarts this plan and manipulates Meyra. Yeliz, meanwhile, is determined to investigate Dilşah's past and uncover her dark side. Through the detective she hires, she obtains crucial information about Dilşah's past. She's determined to tell her father, Çetin. Selim's family, believing Selim has told Meyra he wants a divorce, decide to make a new move. Eda and Oğuz go to Istanbul to see Meyra. Their sole purpose is to tell Meyra not to divorce Selim. However, Meyra has no knowledge of the divorce.

1.title: FR - Aşk ve Gözyaşı [VOSTFR] - S01E04 - Episode 4
1.plot: Meyra and Selim's relationship continues to walk on a thin rope between love and distrust. Taking refuge with Selim's family in Izmit, the couple briefly recaptures the warmth of old times. However, Meyra's illness and increasing forgetfulness erode the trust in their relationship. Meanwhile, Meyra's family loses all trust in the groom because of the listening device found in the house and the divorce protocol in the safe. Çetin gives Selim three days to reveal the truth. The mounting pressure and gossip cast a shadow over both the couple's relationship and the family's reputation. Unable to bear it any longer, Selim confesses that he had prepared a divorce petition in the past without Meyra's knowledge. This confession brings Meyra's repressed memories to the surface one by one; broken trust gives way to indescribable disappointment. For the couple, caught between love and regret, nothing will ever be the same again.

1.title: FR - Aşk ve Gözyaşı [VOSTFR] - S01E05 - Episode 5
1.plot: As Meyra's illness progresses, her mind becomes confused; she can no longer distinguish reality from fantasy. Ercan, who secretly loves her, attempts to take advantage of this situation. Meyra, momentarily mistaking Ercan for Selim, draws closer to him. Just then, Selim arrives, overcome with rage and beats Ercan. Meyra, however, doesn't understand what has happened; she doesn't even remember what happened. After this incident, Selim is consumed by both a protective instinct and a profound sense of guilt. Although Meyra tries to stay away from him, Selim is always there for her during her crisis. The old love between them resurfaces with pain and regret. As Ercan's schemes continue, Meyra struggles with both her illness and the love she still harbors for Selim. This tense balance between the three turns into a turning point, where a misunderstanding that begins with a kiss escalates and changes everyone's fate.

1.title: FR - Aşk ve Gözyaşı [VOSTFR] - S01E06 - Episode 6
1.plot: Meyra’s condition worsens, and as she hovers between life and death, she and Selim once again try to hold on to each other. Just when it seems like things are finally improving, tragedy strikes, with Ercan’s death, Selim finds himself in prison, accused of murder. As Meyra is taken to Germany for treatment, fate once again intervenes to separate them. Ten months pass. Selim, now a strong and composed lawyer, begins a new chapter in his life, but the scars of the past remain etched in his heart, especially the lingering hurt and unresolved love he still feels for Meyra. Meanwhile, just as Meyra is about to launch her own company, she is mysteriously kidnapped, only to come face to face with Selim. Old wounds reopen as love, betrayal, and vengeance intertwine. Yet until the truth of their feelings is finally spoken, the tragedies of their past will continue to resurface, refusing to let either of them move on.

1.title: FR - Aşk ve Gözyaşı [VOSTFR] - S01E07 - Episode 7
1.plot: Meyra and Selim’s love turns into a confrontation between betrayal and conscience. Selim learns that Meyra hid the truth in court to protect her brother Harun, destroying the trust between them. As Meyra’s family falls apart, Selim’s love and anger collide. Still, he doesn’t report Harun’s crime to the police, a moral test he chooses to endure despite his feelings. Meyra is shaken by Selim’s silent sacrifice; though their relationship seems over, the emotional tension between them reignites. Harun’s guilt and escape trigger a tragic chain of events, forcing Meyra to battle for her brother while Selim struggles with justice. Both burdened by the past, they find themselves unable to break away from each other, their love surviving in the middle of a crime, a lie, and an unforgiving heart.

1.title: FR - Güller ve Günahlar [VOSTFR] - S01E01 - Episode 1
1.plot: Serhat Tecer lives a happy life with his wife and daughters—until an unexpected truth turns his world upside down. The great love of his life, his wife Berrak, has been hiding a shocking secret for years: she has another child… Kader. As Serhat begins to unravel the truth, his path crosses with Zeynep—a brave and outspoken woman who becomes his greatest ally when he least expects it. Following every clue step by step, Serhat soon realizes that the key to Berrak’s mysterious, secret-laden past will emerge from the last place he could have imagined.

1.title: FR - Güller ve Günahlar [VOSTFR] - S01E02 - Episode 2
1.plot: Zeynep teams up with Serhat's brother, Cihan Tecer, to find a clue. Meanwhile, Serhat, unaware of all this, is following his own trail. When he sees the white lily left by Berrak's bedside, he thinks he's getting close to the person he's been searching for. A little later, he learns who left the flower. What he feels is not only anger but also immense pain. Zeynep, eager for news from Cihan, discovers where Serhat has gone, but by the time she finds out, it's too late.

1.title: FR - Güller ve Günahlar [VOSTFR] - S01E03 - Episode 3
1.plot: After confronting his brother Can, Serhat tries to uncover the truth about the past by reading the letters Berrak left behind. During this process, the only contact saved on Berrak’s phone is also revealed. As Zeynep and Serhat follow the trail Berrak left behind, they remain unaware of the evil scheme being plotted by Tülay and Erkan, or of the explosive secret that Ebru is about to unleash upon the Tecer family.

1.title: FR - Güller ve Günahlar [VOSTFR] - S01E04 - Episode 4
1.plot: While Serhat is devastated by what Hayal has learned, Cihan grapples with Ebru's unexpected move. New information about Berrak spurs Zeynep and Serhat into action, unaware of what Tibet has planned for them. As Serhat pursues new information, news from the hospital forces him to make a choice.

1.title: FR - Güller ve Günahlar [VOSTFR] - S01E05 - Episode 5
1.plot: The series' plot is as follows: While the Tecer family welcomes Berrak's awakening with joy, Serhat pursues the truth hidden from him, demanding to know who Kader's father is. While Zeynep, realizing it's time for her to leave, expects Berrak to accept Kader as her daughter, Berrak makes a move that will thwart all expectations.

1.title: FR - Güller ve Günahlar [VOSTFR] - S01E06 - Episode 6
1.plot: Kader, influenced by her mother, has returned to Tülay and Erkan. While Zeynep leaves the Tecer house and tries to get Kader back, Serhat talks to his daughters and tries to find ways to get Berrak out of the house. Meanwhile, a phone call from Can forces Serhat to make another choice.

1.title: FR - Güller ve Günahlar [VOSTFR] - S01E07 - Episode 7
1.plot: Accused of treason, Cihan struggles to survive and wants to do Serhat one last favor: tell him who Kader's father is. Zeynep and Kader's return home disrupts Berrak's plans. While Berrak wants to strengthen her position in the house, she is unaware that Cihan is about to reveal her secret.

1.title: FR - Güller ve Günahlar [VOSTFR] - S01E08 - Episode 8
1.plot: After Cihan's confession, Serhat appears before Tibet and beats Tibet to death, causing him to fall into a coma. Serhat, believing Tibet to be dead, wonders how he will explain this to his daughters and Zeynep. When Berrak learns that Cihan has confessed everything to Serhat, she leaves the house quickly, taking the girls with her.  Serhat and Zeynep pursue Berrak to save Hayal and İlkim. However, Zeynep and Serhat are unaware of the danger that awaits them. Berrak, however, confronts Serhat with a completely different plan.

1.title: FR - Güller ve Günahlar [VOSTFR] - S01E09 - Episode 9
1.plot: Just as Serhat is about to confess the truth to İlkim and Hayal, accompanied by a psychologist, Berrak's arrival and her announcement that she's pregnant shock everyone. Serhat has reached the end of the road for Berrak and tells the girls the whole truth. Learning that Kader is their sister, İlkim and Hayal's lives are turned upside down, leaving Kader in tears.  Zeynep, meanwhile, is on the brink of a new opportunity opened for her by Serhat, and she takes action to fulfill her dream of becoming a teacher. Zeynep will support Serhat, both working and helping him recover from the devastation in his family. Meanwhile, Cihan continues to try every possible way to maintain his agreement with Tibet.

meta.plot: New York mafia capo Dwight "The General" Manfredi is released from prison after 25 years and exiled by his boss to set up shop in Tulsa, Oklahoma. Realizing that his mob family may not have his best interests in mind, Dwight slowly builds a crew.

1.title: FR - Tulsa King [vostfr] - S01E01 - Go West, Old Man
1.plot: Dwight, blindsided by the news that his mob family has nothing left for him in New York, is sent to Tulsa, Oklahoma; as he settles in and surveys his new surroundings, Dwight wastes no time making new associates.

1.title: FR - Tulsa King [vostfr] - S01E02 - Center of the Universe
1.plot: Dwight, Tyson, and Bodhi go on a road trip to take care of some business; Stacy does some digging into Dwight's past.

1.title: FR - Tulsa King [vostfr] - S01E03 - Caprice

In 1987, a military helicopter pursues an unknown object which fits the description of the “TIC-TAC” UFO.

They are blessed with children and should be a happy family to anyone who sees them. Feeling something is off about Yudai’s recent behavior, Minori follows him. What catches her eye is the sight of Yudai walking happily with his lover Miyake Riko (Nonami Maho) and her son Miyake Wataru (Nomura Kota). Divorce alone is not enough. The thrilling revenge of a cheated wife begins now!

Wataru slowly opens up to Minori, who kindly gives him advice, and tells him stories of his childhood. As his suspicions deepen, he receives news that his mother, Riko (Nonami Maho), has collapsed. Minori secretly follows Wataru as he heads to the hospital. Yudai arrives late to join Riko and Wataru in their hospital room.

1.title: FR - Until I Destroyed My Husband's Other Family [VOSTFR] - S01E03 - Episode 3
1.plot: Riko (Nonami Maho), the woman her husband had an affair with, was pregnant with Yudai's (Takezai Terunosuke) child. Wataru (Nomura Kota), who knows nothing about it, tells Minori (Matsumoto Marika) about his mother, Riko. Living with Yudai, who keeps telling her lies, slowly eats away at Minori, but as she consults with her best friend Sara (Ota Rina), the flames of revenge begin to quietly burn. Minori heads to the beauty salon run by Riko. The betrayed wife and her lover finally come face to face. An explosive conversation unfolds...!

1.plot: In the 1970s, the brutal murders of sex workers in economically depressed areas of the UK spark little public interest - until a teen is also killed.

1.title: EN - The Ripper [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO]  - S01E02 - Between Now and Dawn
1.plot: As the killer continues to prey upon women, police hope that the tire tracks and a victims 5-pound note may finally lead to a suspect.

1.title: EN - The Ripper [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO]  - S01E03 - Reclaim the Night
1.plot: Police release phone calls and handwriting samples from a suspect. Women protest law enforcements continued inability to catch the Ripper.

1.title: EN - The Ripper [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO]  - S01E04 - Out of the Shadows
1.plot: More than five years after the first attack, police finally make an arrest, setting off a media frenzy and accusations of a botched investigation.

meta.plot: As Nick and Rachel's crimes escalate to bigger and bigger stars, CCTV footage of the Hollywood Hills burglars begins to circulate the gossip blogs. Alexis and her family are on the brink of reality TV fame, but her drug issues spiral.

1.title: EN - Bling Ring: Hollywood Heist [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E02 - Fame, Fortune and Felony

1.plot: The concluding part reveals how the Bling Ring's crimes eventually caught up with them, thrusting them into the centre of a high-profile court case. But the defendants were not the only ones benefiting from the spotlight.

1.title: FR - The Narrow Road to the Deep North - S01E01 - Episode 1
1.plot: While writing a speech for an upcoming book launch, renowned surgeon and celebrated war hero, Dorrigo Evans is thrust back into memories of his time as a POW in WW2 and of his brief, yet unforgettable, love affair with Amy Mulvaney. A love which sustained him through this dark time.

1.title: FR - The Narrow Road to the Deep North - S01E02 - Episode 2
1.plot: We witness the burgeoning love affair between Dorrigo and Amy in the 1940s, which is in stark contrast to his present day marriage to his wife, Ella. The banality of his current life in the 1980s leads Dorrigo to take a risk that puts his surgical career in jeopardy.

1.title: FR - The Narrow Road to the Deep North - S01E03 - Episode 3
1.plot: Dorrigo has come under investigation for a risky procedure he performed, placing a further strain on his marriage. A marriage that is already feeling the effects of Dorrigo's everlasting love for Amy, a love both cannot resist. We also witness Dorrigo's deep love and care towards the soldiers when a cholera outbreak spreads through the POW camp, and his friend Rabbit becomes increasingly unwell.

1.title: FR - The Narrow Road to the Deep North - S01E04 - Episode 4
1.plot: Dorrigo and Amy's affair must end when Dorrigo is shipped off to war, where as a prisoner he bares witness to the most horrific of crimes.

1.title: FR - The Narrow Road to the Deep North - S01E05 - Episode 5
1.plot: Dorrigo returns from war and tries to get on with his life without Amy and many of his friends he lost to the POW camp. While in the present, the day of the book launch arrives and Dorrigo's reflections on his life come to a head.

meta.plot: En 1989, en Australie, Dorrigo Evans, chirurgien renommé et héros de guerre, se prépare à prononcer un discours lors de la sortie d’un ouvrage consacré à la Seconde Guerre mondiale. Cet événement ravive les souvenirs de son passé : en 1943, alors qu’il était médecin militaire fait prisonnier par les Japonais, il fut contraint de travailler sur la ligne de chemin de fer reliant la Thaïlande à la Birmanie. Dans l’enfer de la jungle, entre violence, maladie et perte, il trouva la force de survivre grâce au souvenir de son amour interdit avec Amy Mulvaney, la femme de son oncle.

At last, the long-awaited prequel to the cult sketch Dinner for One. England, early 20th century - a country estate near Eastbourne. Faced with financial hardship, young Miss Sophie decides to get married and invites marriage candidates to her castle. Before she can make her choice, one of the gentlemen is murdered. Miss Sophie challenges the bachelors to witty competitions for her heart and tries to secretly find the murderer. Always at her side is her butler James - and a tender but seemingly impossible romance develops ...

1.title: EN - Miss Sophie: Same Procedure As Every Year [MULTI-SUB] - S01E01 - Happy New Year, Miss Sophie!
1.plot: Miss Sophie is in financial distress. Her solution: She has five men compete for her heart: Mr. Pommeroy, Sir Toby, Mr. Winterbottom, Admiral von Schneider and Count Szabos. The already tricky plan gets completely out of control when Miss Sophie's childhood sweetheart, the butler's son James, appears.

1.title: EN - Miss Sophie: Same Procedure As Every Year [MULTI-SUB] - S01E02 - Game On
1.plot: James, the Butler's son skips a duel to the death to support Miss Sophie in her "Bachelorette" campaign. When the five marriage candidates arrive, each shows his very special temperament. Tension mounts amid etiquette, vanity, and petty taunts. Miss Sophie and James grow closer again, but Sophie's plan remains on track.

1.title: EN - Miss Sophie: Same Procedure As Every Year [MULTI-SUB] - S01E03 - All In
1.plot: Miss Sophie invites the gentlemen on a dream date to Ascot: horse races, strawberry punch, high stakes. At Ascot, Miss Sophie experiences another financial setback. James gets on the trail of a rotten game and ends up exposing one of the marriage candidates as a cheater.

1.title: EN - Miss Sophie: Same Procedure As Every Year [MULTI-SUB] - S01E04 - Cheers, Admiral!
1.plot: Admiral von Schneider organizes a one-on-one date for Miss Sophie, which is anything but conventional. Between questionable "medicine" and disarming confessions, the gentlemen show their true colors. In the end, one of the marriage candidates draws conclusions and throws in the towel.

1.title: EN - Miss Sophie: Same Procedure As Every Year [MULTI-SUB] - S01E05 - The Village of Truth
1.plot: Then there were only two! For his dream date, one bachelor takes the group to France, to the “Village of Truth.” The village lives up to its promise—Miss Sophie and James confront their feelings, and one marriage candidate makes a surprising confession.

1.title: EN - Miss Sophie: Same Procedure As Every Year [MULTI-SUB] - S01E06 - Same Procedure Every Year
1.plot: After the trip to France, the way seems clear for the remaining bachelor. But he also has a lot of skeletons in his closet, and in the end, it's not just about the beginning of a great love, but also about life and death.

meta.plot: A 10-part documentary chronicling the untold story of Michael Jordan and the Chicago Bulls dynasty with rare, never-before-seen footage and sound from the 1997-98 championship season – plus over 100 interviews with famous figures and basketball’s biggest names.

Ever wonder what's happening inside your head? From dreaming to anxiety disorders, discover how your brain works with this illuminating series.

1.title: EN - The Mind, Explained [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E01 - Memory
1.plot: How does remembering work? Delve into the way the brain stores, processes and retrieves memories -- and why certain ones sometimes prove unreliable.

1.plot: Why do we dream? When the lights go out, interesting things happen in the brain and body. What’s the significance of dreams, and what can they teach us?

1.title: EN - The Mind, Explained [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E03 - Anxiety
1.plot: Feeling anxious? You're not alone. Stand-up comedian Maria Bamford shares her personal experience with OCD in this examination of anxiety disorders.

1.title: EN - The Mind, Explained [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E04 - Mindfulness
1.plot: Take a deep, cleansing breath and slowly exhale while being enlightened on the impact meditation can have on your mind and body.

2.title: EN - The Mind, Explained [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S02E03 - Personality
2.plot: Personality tests group people into handy types but reveal only part of the story. Learn how our personalities develop and evolve over a lifetime.

2.title: EN - The Mind, Explained [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S02E04 - Creativity
2.plot: Creativity isn't a mystical force — it's a mental muscle. See how your neural networks generate fresh ideas and learn ways to foster your imagination.

2.title: EN - The Mind, Explained [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S02E05 - Brainwashing
2.plot: What does it mean to be brainwashed? From the Satanic panic of the ’80s to current conspiracies, dive into how belief change happens inside the brain.

Dana conducts Dino Experiment 618: What does it feel like to go as fast as a Compsognathus, the fastest dinosaur? When Grandma watches over Dana, Dana's disappointed because she and Dad planned to transform her bike into a Dromaeosaurus for Dino Experiment 612: How does a Psittacosaurus use its tail quills to protect itself.

2.plot: Dana comes across a herd of traveling sauropods and learns about why and how they migrate. Using what she learns she helps Mr. Hendrickson's move into a new home a little easier. Dana and her family plan to have a picnic lunch, but find their picnic basket has been slashed. The family heads to Dino Court, to try "The Case of the Picnic Basket Slasher".

2.plot: Ms. Currie asks Dana to help her choose a reptile that's most like a dinosaur to adopt for Trek's upcoming birthday. Dana neglects to do her part to help take care of Nixon because she's too preoccupied with Dino Experiment 620: How do Edmontosaurus take care of their babies.

2.plot: At Grandma's farm Dana conducts Dino Experiment 625: What does it feel like to ride a Hippodraco? With Grandma's guidance and Saara's love of horses, they help Dana learn what it feels like to ride a "Horse Dragon". Dana wants to stay up all night to do Dino Experiment 623: Are there nocturnal dinosaurs? But her Dad's just come back from a late hospital shift and wants to go to bed.

2.title: FR - Dino Dana - S02E08 - Saaratops/Raising Dino Expectations
2.plot: Dana uses her time at Grandma's farm to conduct Dino Experiment 615: Who would win in a fight? A Triceratops, Diabloceratops, or Kosmoceratops? Dana, Grandma and Saara all get invested and choose a dino to root for. Dana discovers the differences between dino and human babies a when Mom's friend Ashley and her new baby Ben stop by for a visit.

2.plot: When Dana, Saara and Uncle Ravi go gokarting together, Dana learns helpful techniques from a nearby Stygimoloch to help as they race each other. Dana is doing Dino Experiment 624: Why does the baby Brachiosaurus eat so much? Meanwhile, Saara adeals with her very first face pimple, an early sign of growing up.

meta.plot: Academy Award-winning documentary filmmaker, Jean-Xavier de Lestrade, presents a gripping courtroom thriller, offering a rare and revealing inside look at a high-profile murder trial. In 2001, author Michael Peterson was arraigned for the murder of his wife Kathleen, whose body was discovered lying in a pool of blood on the stairway of their home. Granted unusual access to Peterson's lawyers, home and immediate family, de Lestrade's cameras capture the defense team as it considers its strategic options. The series is an engrossing look at contemporary American justice that features more twists than a legal bestseller.

1.title: FR - Le Temps des mouches - S01E02 - The Price of Poison
1.plot: After learning the cost of Manca's biopsy, Inés weighs a risky but lucrative offer from Susana Bonar — a wealthy client who won't take no for an answer.

1.title: FR - Le Temps des mouches - S01E03 - Life Goes On

1.title: FR - Le Temps des mouches - S01E05 - The Point of No Return

1.title: FR - Le Temps des mouches - S01E06 - Time Flies
1.plot: While Manca undergoes surgery, Inés learns of Bonar's macabre plan — and must act fast when those she loves most appear to be in danger.

meta.plot: À peine sorties de prison et sans options, deux femmes gèrent une société de désinfection, jusqu'à ce qu'une cliente louche les ramène à la vie qu'elles espéraient tant fuir.
Une employée modèle et le charmant fils du patron se disputent le poste de PDG d'une grande entreprise de lingerie, mais une idylle menace de faire capoter leur projet.

1.plot: While the team gossips about a secret project, Mateo pounces on Graciela's client, Pedro does the dirty work for his ex and Lari demands a new office.

1.title: FR - Bureau des cœurs - S01E03 - The Honeymoon
1.plot: Pedro's jealousy stirs up new office rules. Graciela and Mateo go head-to-head with new designs. Mr. Enrique feels pressure from his ex — and his wife.

1.title: FR - Bureau des cœurs - S01E04 - Whitexicans
1.plot: While Graciela and Mateo dress up to confront a rival over stolen designs, Bobby's plan to find a traitor at Sofintim reveals unexpected truths.

1.title: FR - Bureau des cœurs - S01E05 - What's Up Pussycat?
1.plot: At an expo in Guadalajara, Lari ruffles feathers, Mateo leaves his privilege behind and Graciela tries to impress their Korean partners — without models.

1.title: FR - Bureau des cœurs - S01E06 - The Sock
1.plot: Regina helms a focus group for a potential new luxury line. Meanwhile, rumors spread after the team's wild work trip, leaving some searching for answers.

1.title: FR - Bureau des cœurs - S01E07 - Bluffing
1.plot: As his decision nears, Mr. Enrique gives Graciela and Mateo one final task each, causing attitudes — and loyalties — to shift within the Sofintim team.

1.title: FR - Bureau des cœurs - S01E08 - Classic Diva
1.plot: The success of their luxurious lingerie showcase decides the next CEO of Sofintim. But what's more important to Graciela and Mateo: passion — or power?

meta.plot: Le soldat, Jonathan Pine, est devenu directeur de nuit dans un hôtel. Il croise la route de Sophie, une proche de Richard Onslow Roper, qui opère sur le marché noir des armes. Sophie fournit à Pine des documents incriminant Roper. Pine essaie d'infiltrer le cercle intime de Roper en devenant un criminel lui-même, tout en gardant secrète sa mission de ses collègues et de sa conjointe.

1.title: FR - The Night Manager - S01E01 - Episode 1

1.title: FR - The Night Manager - S01E02 - Episode 2
