Soon after he moves to Nankatsu, he starts in Nankatsu's match against their rival Syutetsu. Syutetsu's goalie, Genzo, completely underestimates Nankatsu, but a stranger, Tsubasa plays superbly. In everyone's astonishment, Nankatsu scores off the iron goalie, Genzo. Then, a mysterious traveling man who's enchanted by Tsubasa's play shows up...

1.title: FR - Olive et Tom - Le Retour - S01E02 - Meeting Roberto
1.plot: Roberto Hongo loses his career as a soccer player for an eye injury. He is friends with Tsubas's father who is a captain of a ship, and comes to stay at Tsubasa's house in Japan. Nankatsu members find out he is a great soccer player in Brazil and ask him to coach them. The first thing Roberto teaches them is to "be friends with a soccer ball." The team is stunned to see Roberto's overhead kick performance.

1.title: FR - Olive et Tom - Le Retour - S01E03 - Taro Misaki Returns
1.plot: The annual Nankatsu city soccer tournament opens. Tsubasa's Nankatsu elementary school practices hard and plays Wakabayashi's Syutetsu elementary school in the final. Nankatsu plays good defense and shuts out Syutetsu in the first half. Frustrated Wakabayashi makes a stunning long shot in the second half, and Syutetsu starts playing their game. Ishizaki goes out for an injury and Nankatsu almost loses the match. Then, a boy shows up at Nankatsu's bench...

1.title: FR - Olive et Tom - Le Retour - S01E04 - The Burning Kojiro
1.plot: Nankatsu city forms a representative team for the boy's national soccer championship. While the players are not playing together as a team at the start of practice, a boy jumps in. He is Kojiro Hyuga, the captain of Saitama's best team, Meiwa FC. Hyuga shoots a powerful shot to test Genzo Wakabayashi's skill. Misaki, a former teammate of Hyuga, tells the team of Hyuga's aggressive personality and how good Meiwa FC is. Tsubasa and Nankatsu FC players get renewed spirits toward the championship.

1.title: FR - Olive et Tom - Le Retour - S01E05 - Birth! Captain Tsubasa
1.plot: Nankatsu and Syutetsu combo team, Nankatsu FC, plays their first regional match in Shizuoka. Kisugi, Izawa and Taki don't like Nankatsu players and don't pass them the ball. Genzo gets frustrated and orders them to pass to Tsubasa. They do it reluctantly at first, but as they exchange passes through Tsubasa, Nankatsu FC starts penetrating the defense easily. Nankatsu FC starts playing together and makes it to the final.

1.title: FR - Olive et Tom - Le Retour - S01E06 - Opening! Japan National Junior Competition
1.plot: The boy's National Soccer Championship begins. Tsubasa's Nankatsu FC faces Hyuga's Meiwa FC in the first match. Genzo is out for injury, and Hyuga says Nankatsu FC is no match for his team. Hyuga's aggressive play dominates the match. Tsubasa struggles to stop him but Hyuga scores.

1.title: FR - Olive et Tom - Le Retour - S01E07 - Ace of Glass
1.plot: Nankatsu lost their first game but won the rest, and plays the semi-final game against Musashi FC, led by a great player, Jun Misugi. Jun dominates the game but Musashi FC's assistant, Yayoi, is worried. When Tsubasa and Jun struggle for the ball, Tsubasa elbows Jun's chest and....

1.title: FR - Olive et Tom - Le Retour - S01E08 - Get up! Misugi Jun
1.plot: Tsubasa is shocked to find out about Jun's heart disease. Jun plays great, although holding his chest. Tsubasa, though, is so worried about Misugi that he can't play. Tsubasa agonizes but when he realizes that Jun expects him to play his best, he starts playing his game.

1.title: FR - Olive et Tom - Le Retour - S01E09 - Crash! Tsubasa vs. Hyuga
1.plot: The boy's national soccer championship final between Meiwa and Nankatsu starts. Besides the battle between Hyuga and Tsubasa, it’s also the battle between the Wakas as Nankatsu got its goalie, WAKAbayashi Genzo back and Meiwa got a new goalie, WAKAshimazu Ken. Genzo comes back and lifts the team's spirits. Meiwa also has a new goalie, Ken Wakashimazu. Ken uses his karate skill to defend the goal, and Genzo plays hard to defend his. The game goes into an overtime.

1.title: FR - Olive et Tom - Le Retour - S01E10 - Finals in the Dead Heat!
1.plot: The boy's national soccer championship final goes into overtime. Nankatsu and Meiwa players do their best fighting fatigue and injury. Tsubasa and Hyuga also play hard to no avail, and the match goes into injury time. At the last minute, Tsubasa goes for an overhead shot...

1.title: FR - Olive et Tom - Le Retour - S01E11 - Farewell Roberto
1.plot: After Tsubasa wins the boy's national soccer championship, Matsumoto, Toho School's scout, comes to make him an offer. Tsubasa is surprised to find out Hyuga will play for Toho. He's also shocked to learn that Taro is leaving for France and Genzo for Germany. Tsubasa feels lonely, and Roberto teaches him a new shot. Roberto tells him he'll need the shot someday, and leaves Tsubasa's house the next day...

1.title: FR - Olive et Tom - Le Retour - S01E12 - Tomorrow's Kick Off
1.plot: Tsubasa plays his last game for the Brancos, Brazil, and reminisces his old days in the elementary school. Meeting Ishizaki after he transferred school, challenging Genzo for the first time, playing with Taro who became his partner as the golden duo, playing his rival players such as Hyuga, Jun, Ken, in the Boy's National Championship and farewell to Roberto. Tsubasa continued playing soccer, grew up in the field, and now he feels one with his rivals and friends through soccer.

1.title: FR - Olive et Tom - Le Retour - S01E13 - Fierce Tiger Shot!
1.plot: Tsubasa's Nankatsu junior high wins the national soccer championship two years in a row, and now they practice to win the third. Hyuga's Toho loses to Nankatsu two years in a row. Hyuga has a burning desire to beat Tsubasa, however the gap between Toho coach Kitazume's vision and Hyuga's is widening. That's when Hyuga's old coach Kira shows up.

1.title: FR - Olive et Tom - Le Retour - S01E14 - A Challenge From Jito
1.plot: Tsubasa's last national junior high school soccer championship opens. Tsubasa's worried about Hyuga not playing for Toho school. Nankatsu plays their first game against a big guy, Jito's Hirado junior high. Jito charges at Tsubasa for power defense.

1.title: FR - Olive et Tom - Le Retour - S01E15 - Hot Number 10 from a Snow Country
1.plot: Tsubasa hurts his shoulder in the first game of the championship but goes to the semi-final. Nankatsu plays a tough game against Furano, led by their captain Matsuyama who're determined to break the jinx of northern teams which cannot win the championship. Furano plays as a team rather than dependent on individual skills, and they wear bandannas made by the team assistant Yoshiko. The bandanna she made for Matsuyama also has a special message for him.

1.title: FR - Olive et Tom - Le Retour - S01E16 - Upsetting Doctor's Decision
1.plot: Tsubasa's shoulder condition worsens after the semi-final game against Furano, and his doctor tells him not to play in the final. Genzo visits him from his team, which happens to be staying in Japan for a training match. Genzo takes Tsubasa to his team doctor, Stein, who's famous in the field of sports medicine. Tsubasa also learns of the high level of Genzo's team. Tsubasa gets the diagnosis.

1.title: FR - Olive et Tom - Le Retour - S01E17 - Tournament Final! Nankatsu vs. Toho
1.plot: Dr. Stein permits Tsubasa to play half of the final game. Toho's Hyuga gives a challenge to his coach Kitazume. Hyuga and his teammates bow to apologize and Kitazume decides to use him as a starter. On the day of the final, Hyuga rushes out to the field, but Tsubasa is not there.

1.title: FR - Olive et Tom - Le Retour - S01E18 - Driving Shot of Vengeance
1.plot: At the half time of the championship final, Toho leads Nankatsu by 3 to 0. Tsubasa finally comes in in the second half and encourages Nankatsu players, but Hyuga is calm. Tsubasa leads the team to score back 3, but Toho adds another score. The time is running out but Tsubasa plays hard despite of his shoulder injury. Tsubasa finally scores in the end and the game goes into overtime.

1.title: FR - Olive et Tom - Le Retour - S01E19 - Come Back! Tsubasa!
1.plot: Tsubasa scores a game tying shot at the end of the second half of the final game against Toho, but he passes out for his shoulder pain. He wakes up in a doctor's office, determined to play in overtime despite of the doctor's warning. Huega is stunned at Tsubasa's fighting spirit. Both teams play hard. The time is running out...

1.title: FR - Olive et Tom - Le Retour - S01E20 - Go for it! Japan Junior Youth Team!
1.plot: Tsubasa played well in the national junior high school soccer championship and was selected for Japan junior youth team with his rivals such as Hyuga. However, Tsubasa cannot join the camp for his shoulder injury. He watches his rivals develop skill in practice, and looks forward to joining the team. But Tsubasa's name is not on the list of the members going to France...

1.title: FR - Olive et Tom - Le Retour - S01E21 - Humiliating Test Match
1.plot: For the first test match in Europe, Japan junior youth team challenges Wakabayashi's FC Gurenbald. Genzo has now become a great goalkeeper and Japan team cannot score. Also, Schneider scores a hat trick in the first half. When Japan team's spirit is down, Tsubasa shows up. He came out of his injury and Japan team is excited for the expectation. However, coach Mikami declares he can't use Tsubasa for the game.

1.title: FR - Olive et Tom - Le Retour - S01E22 - Glorious Number 10
1.plot: Japan junior youth team was scheduled to play Italy, however, Italy cancels the match after watching Japan lose to Gurenbald. Tsubasa takes it personal and dribbles to the Italy team. He penetrates Italian players and scores using the drive shot. He's recovered from his injury. In Japan's next game, Tsubasa is standing on the field in the number 10 uniform.

1.title: FR - Olive et Tom - Le Retour - S01E23 - Golden Duo Reunites
1.plot: Katagiri visits Taro who has been living in Paris with his father since he left Nankatsu. Katagiri offers him to play for the Japan team, but Taro has concerns. Tsubasa goes to see him, and the duo reunites. Taro talks to Tsubasa about his concerns and decides to join the Japan team. Japan team with the Golden Duo enters the International Junior Youth Tournament's opening ceremony

1.title: FR - Olive et Tom - Le Retour - S01E24 - 'God of Defense' of Italy
1.plot: Japan plays the International Junior Youth's first match against Italy. Japan plays a tough match against Italy's goalkeeper, Hernandez and gives up a score. However, Taro goes in as a substitute and Japan ties by Taro and Tsubasa's combination play. Italy restructures defense under Hernandez' direction and time passes by with no score. At the last minute, Tsubasa's shot is blocked by Hernandez, but Hyuga rushes to the ball...

1.title: FR - Olive et Tom - Le Retour - S01E25 - Genius Juan Diaz!
1.plot: Japan vs. Argentine. Japan must win this game to go to the final round, but Argentine's ace, Diaz, scores 3 against Japan. Tsubasa still manages to frustrate Diaz. Tsubasa reorganizes Japan team to score back one by one, and Diaz gets hot. Tsubasa plays with his team but Diaz persists in playing one-on-one with Tsubasa and challenges him...

1.title: FR - Olive et Tom - Le Retour - S01E26 - An Elegant Commander
1.plot: Japan plays France in the semi-final game. Japan scores first but France's mid-fielder, Pierre, penetrates Japan's defense with his fantastic skill and ties the game. Soda also gets a yellow card for a rumble. Pierre plays superb offense and centers the ball to Napoleon. Soda tries to stop Napoleon and his elbow hits Napoleon's face. The referee throws Soda out of the game for his second yellow card.

1.title: FR - Olive et Tom - Le Retour - S01E27 - Painful Yellow Card
1.plot: Tsubasa protests the referee for Soda's yellow card and ends up getting one for himself. France scores a penalty kick and Japan tries to catch up with 10 players. However, the referee gives all close calls to France, and cancels Japan's three goals. France adds another score and the first half is over. The Japan team is frustrated back in the locker room. Tsubasa's worried but remembers Roberto's word of wisdom.

1.title: FR - Olive et Tom - Le Retour - S01E28 - Respectable Penalty - Tie-Breaker
1.plot: After Soda goes out of the match, Japan plays with 10 players, and Wakashimazu also hurts his right arm. Japan occasionally plays offense in vain. The game goes to a penalty tie-breaker. Hyuga, Matsuyama, Taro and Jun score. Ken stops France's 5th kicker, Napoleon's shot. Now, Japan's 5th kicker, Tsubasa, stands ready.

1.title: FR - Olive et Tom - Le Retour - S01E29 - Grueling Battle! Japan vs. Germany
1.plot: Japan beats France and goes to the International Junior Youth's final game against Schneider's Germany. Ken is out for injury and Genzo plays goalkeeper for Japan for the first time in the tournament. On the other hand, a mysterious goalkeeper Dieter Muller plays for Germany. Tsubasa, Nitta, Izawa and Hyuga take a shot early in the game but Mueller catches all shots.

1.title: FR - Olive et Tom - Le Retour - S01E30 - A Message from Roberto
1.plot: It's half time of Japan - Germany game. Japan is down by one. Katagiri gives Tsubasa a message from Roberto, "remember page 52 of the note." During the game, Tsubasa remembers Roberto's words from his soccer note, which is full of useful advice. When he remembers what's on page 52, he gets second wind, and he also finds Roberto in the stadium.

1.title: FR - Olive et Tom - Le Retour - S01E31 - Shine in Glory! Japanese Team!
1.plot: Hyuga gets Tsubasa's pass, smashes his Neo Tiger Shot into Germany's goal, and finally puts Japan team on top. However, Kaltz and Schneider's offense penetrates Japan's struggling defense and scores a game tying goal. Japan team is depressed but Tsubasa lifts their spirit. Roberto is happy to see Tsubasa's leadership, but Tsubasa crashes Kaltz and falls down on the field....

1.title: FR - Olive et Tom - Le Retour - S01E32 - To the New Field
1.plot: Tsubasa wins his third junior high school championship title and leaves for Brazil. He takes a test to join Roberto's FC Brancos. Another applicant, Pepe, is jealous of Tsubasa's brand new pair of shoes. Pepe dreams of having a good life as a soccer player, and cannot accept Tsubasa who came from a rich country. Now, the test starts.

1.title: FR - Olive et Tom - Le Retour - S01E33 - A Soccer Cyborg
1.plot: Tsubasa joins the Brancos, becomes a regular member of the top team, and plays Carlos Santana of Domingo. He scores first and comments that the ball is his friend, but Santana despises his attitude. Santana controls the ball accurately and scores back. Tsubasa is surprised by Santana's strength but disagrees to his style.

1.title: FR - Olive et Tom - Le Retour - S01E34 - Santana, The Son of God
1.plot: Santana remembers his childhood during a Brancos and Domingo match. Santana used to be a normal boy who loved soccer but lost his grandparents who had raised him in an accident. A wealthy man, Barla, had known Santana's talent and conspired to have him join his team. Santana resisted but Barla told him that he was an abandoned child and shocked him.

1.title: FR - Olive et Tom - Le Retour - S01E35 - The Shine of Rosario
1.plot: The soccer cyborg, Santana, threw away everything else but soccer. But as he plays Tsubasa in the game, he loses his machine-like accuracy. Leo, who grew up with Santana, now sees the change in Santana and expects Tsubasa to melt Santana's cold heart. The game is in injury time, and it's the last play. Tsubasa and Santana rush to the loose ball.

1.title: FR - Olive et Tom - Le Retour - S01E36 - The New Dream Land
1.plot: Tsubasa leaves Brazil to transfer to a European team. Hyuga announces a transfer to F.C. Piemonte in Italy at the same time. Tsubasa visits Catalunya F.C. in Spain, sees their main stadium and decides to transfer there.

1.title: FR - Olive et Tom - Le Retour - S01E37 - Huega's Challenge for the Future
1.plot: Hyuga goes to F.C. Piemonte's home stadium in Italy. He joins the players' individual practice before a camp, and declares he'll aim for the leading scorer. Willem of the Dutch national team stands in his way.

1.title: FR - Olive et Tom - Le Retour - S01E38 - Golden Age of Hope
1.plot: Tsubasa, Genzo, Hyuga, Taro in Europe get offers to be on the Japan national team to play a training match against Holland. They find out all the other candidates are from the world junior youth champion team. However, they hear a rumor that Holland is not pleased with the Japanese selection of the young players...

1.title: FR - Olive et Tom - Le Retour - S01E39 - Shingo Aoi Is Here!
1.plot: A match against Holland is coming up for the Japan national team. A new player, Shingo Aoi, joins the team. Ken finds out that he's just a second goalkeeper to Genzo and leaves the camp. Katagiri tells Ken a story about Aoi who went to Italy all by himself after junior high school.

1.title: FR - Olive et Tom - Le Retour - S01E40 - The New Japan National Team
1.plot: The test match between Japan and Holland kicks off. Tsubasa and Hyuga lead Japan's offense at the beginning, but the Dutch defense blocks it easily. Holland starts dominating. Genzo saves the goal nicely but gives up a score.

1.title: FR - Olive et Tom - Le Retour - S01E41 - Break the Dutch Wall
1.plot: Japan gave up a goal to Holland in the first half, so they sends in Jun to stabilize defense and focus on offense in the second half. Japan tries to score many times but can't break the Holland's iron defense. Japan sends in Aoi to stir things up.

1.title: FR - Olive et Tom - Le Retour - S01E42 - Restart to the World
1.plot: After the Holland match, Japan national team members go back to their club teams to retrain themselves for the coming international cup games. Hyuga goes to Okinawa, Tsubasa to Hawaii. The Holland match made them realize the high world standard.

1.title: FR - Olive et Tom - Le Retour - S01E43 - Catalunya's Eagle
1.plot: Tsubasa goes back to Spain to join F.C.Catalunya's camp. On the first day, Tsubasa challenges Rivaul to a one-on-one match and gets beaten completely. In Italy, F.C.Piemonte's physical coach, Mazzantini calls Hyuga a failure as a soccer player for his unbalanced body.

1.title: FR - Olive et Tom - Le Retour - S01E44 - Run to the Opening Match!
1.plot: On the second day of F.C.Catalunya's camp, the coach sets up a training match. Tsubasa was knocked down by Rivaul the day before, but he gets to play Rivaul again behind two tops in B team. Tsubasa gets knocked down but he keeps challenging.

1.title: FR - Olive et Tom - Le Retour - S01E45 - Harsh Notice
1.plot: At Catalunya's camp, the coach tests Tsubasa on different positions in A team, and Tsubasa performs well at all positions. At the same time in Piemonte, Hyuga gets respect by his teammates for his powerful shot. When it is set that Hyuga will debut as a starting member for his team in the opening match, Tsubasa's coach gives Tsubasa unbelievable notice.

1.title: FR - Olive et Tom - Le Retour - S01E46 - Cross the Bridge of Hope
1.plot: The coach tells Tsubasa to play for Catalunya B in division 2 instead of the top team. Tsubasa's old teammates gets the news all over the world. Hyuga tells him to go to Italy but he refuses by saying he can't run away. Tsubasa runs in the streets of Barcelona to fight the pain and renews his hope on a hill looking over the city.

1.title: FR - Olive et Tom - Le Retour - S01E47 - Huega's Italian Debut
1.plot: Hyuga plays Piemonte's opening match of the Italian league against A.C.Emilia as a starting member. The match kicks off and Hyuga cuts in Emilia's defense but defense makes him lose balance. However, he uses wit and lets the other forward, Franchesco, score the first goal for the team. The fans are happy about Hyuga's first assist but the referee blows a whistle.

1.title: FR - Olive et Tom - Le Retour - S01E48 - Striker in Tears
1.plot: Hyuga plays his debut match in the Italian League, but tough & rough defense stops him from taking a shot on goal. He is substituted at the 31st minute of the first half. He leaves the field in tears and swears to improve his physical balance to be a regular player. On the other hand, Tsubasa plays a Spanish Division Two match with renewed spirits.

1.title: FR - Olive et Tom - Le Retour - S01E49 - Go for 10 Goals, 10 Assists!
1.plot: Catalunya's coach Eduard requests Tsubasa to score 10 goals and 10 assists in Division Two in a year. Tsubasa tries to do it in a single match, his debut match. He scores 6 goals and 4 assists and impresses the crowd. Hyuga in Italy and Wakabayashi in Germany support Tsubasa for their friendship and mutual goal to win the International Cup as Japan national team.

1.title: FR - Olive et Tom - Le Retour - S01E50 - Battle Against the Rival
1.plot: Genzo's Gruenbald plays the German League champion, Schneider's Routburg. Gruenbald scores first by Genzo and Kaltz's clever play, but Routburg's passing tactic leads to Schneider's score. Genzo, Schneider and Kaltz used to be teammates but now they're enemies. Schneider provokes Kaltz to kick him, and Kaltz gets sent out. Genzo tries to tie the game by taking a free kick in the injury time but misses it and Schneider takes advantage to score a game winner.

1.title: FR - Olive et Tom - Le Retour - S01E51 - Dream Pitch
1.plot: Tsubasa meets coach Eduard's requirement to score 10 goals and10 assists for Catalunya B team and gets to play for the top team. Tsubasa's old rival in Brazil, Santana, transfers to Catalunya's rival, San Jose in the Spanish League. Rivaul gets injured during the match against San Jose, and Tsubasa goes in to play against Santana.

1.title: FR - Olive et Tom - Le Retour - S01E52 - Warriors in the Field
1.plot: Rivaul is injured and Tsubasa gets his first chance to play in the top team of Catalunya. The opponent's Santana plays superbly but Tsubasa manages to score a goal to tie the game. Hyuga also gets the last 5 minutes of game time and shows off his training results by scoring a game-winning goal. Genzo also saves his rival, Schneider's shot in the last match of the German League. Japan team now gets together back in Japan to play the International Cup games of their dream.

meta.plot: Derek is a loyal nursing home caretaker who sees only the good in his quirky co-workers as they struggle against prejudice and shrinking budgets to care for their elderly residents.

1.title: EN - Derek [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E01 - Episode 1
1.plot: A visit from the council sees Broadhill retirement home facing closure. Hannah, the home's manager, rallies together her troops, best mates Derek, Dougie and Kev.

1.title: EN - Derek [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E02 - Episode 2
1.plot: It's Derek's 50th birthday; what better way to celebrate than with a party at Broadhill retirement home?

1.title: EN - Derek [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E03 - Episode 3
1.plot: Derek is desperate to save the life of a baby bird that's fallen from a tree. Some of the residents attend a jumble sale. And Hannah forgets about her date with Tom.

1.title: EN - Derek [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E04 - Episode 4
1.plot: Derek decides to sell some of his autographs to raise money for the retirement home. But it doesn't go too well when he can't remember who the autographs belong to.

1.title: EN - Derek [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E05 - Episode 5
1.plot: Derek forms an entertainment committee to discuss plans for a cabaret show at Broadhill. Kev wants to produce a play of his Duran Duran film script, starring staff and residents as the band.

1.title: EN - Derek [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E06 - Episode 6
1.plot: A much-loved resident is in decline, which sets in motion a sequence of events culminating in the appearance of an unexpected visitor.

1.title: EN - Derek [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E07 -

2.title: EN - Derek [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S02E01 - Episode 1
2.plot: All the old Broadhill faces are back, alongside some new ones. Derek's happy that his dad's moving in, while Tom and Hannah are taking things to another level.

2.title: EN - Derek [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S02E02 - Episode 2
2.plot: There are job opportunities at Broadhill so Kev decides to clean up his act. Vicky's taste in men worries Hannah, while a visit from city boy Pete stirs things up for Derek.

2.title: EN - Derek [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S02E03 - Episode 3
2.plot: Hannah and Tom have happy news, and Derek's dad Anthony goes on a date with Tom's nan. But matters of the heart are taking a downward turn for Kev, who calls on his brother Cliff for help.

2.title: EN - Derek [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S02E04 - Episode 4
2.plot: Derek and the Broadhill gang go on a trip to London Zoo. It's Derek's best day ever, as he meets giraffes, penguins and aardvarks, while Vicky meets the man of her dreams.

2.title: EN - Derek [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S02E05 - Episode 5
2.plot: The Meadway animal rescue centre comes to visit, and for Derek that means playing with Ivor. Kev exercises his artistic talents, winding up Hannah in the process, while Derek deals with sad news.

2.title: EN - Derek [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S02E06 - Episode 6
2.plot: Derek goes on a date with a girl from a dating website. He's excited but he's also worried about his dad's health. True to form, Geoff nearly ruins things for Derek, but Kev stands up to him.

3.title: EN - Derek [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S03E01 -

meta.plot: In this docuseries, meet the heroes on the front lines of the battle against influenza and learn about their efforts to stop the next global outbreak.

1.title: EN - Pandemic: How to Prevent an Outbreak [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E01 - It Hunts Us
1.plot: In this introduction to life on the front lines, doctors in the U.S. and Asia battle the flu, and researchers race to develop a universal vaccine.

1.title: EN - Pandemic: How to Prevent an Outbreak [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E02 - Pandemic Is Now
1.plot: Vaccine debates rage while health-care workers inoculate against the Ebola virus in Congo and influenza in detainee camps at the U.S.-Mexico border.

1.title: EN - Pandemic: How to Prevent an Outbreak [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E03 - Seek, Don't Hide
1.plot: Worldwide, scientists test animals and their handlers for emerging viruses. In the U.S. and India, doctors work long hours caring for flu patients.

1.title: EN - Pandemic: How to Prevent an Outbreak [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E04 - Hold On to Your Roots
1.plot: Anti-vaccine debate escalates, and medical staff are attacked in Congo. Funding cuts hit hard in the U.S., but researchers in Guatemala make strides.

1.title: EN - Pandemic: How to Prevent an Outbreak [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E05 - Prayers Might Work
1.plot: Around the world, community, family and faith help physicians and medical advocates stay strong in the face of long hours and a relentless disease.

1.title: EN - Pandemic: How to Prevent an Outbreak [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E06 - Don't Stop Now
1.plot: Successes for some balance setbacks for others. Meanwhile, viral outbreaks continue to claim lives across the globe — and a larger pandemic looms.

meta.plot: Les exploits d'un groupe de vikings de la fin du 8ème siècle jusqu'au milieu du 11ème, mené par Ragnar Lodbrok, l'un des plus populaires héros viking de tous les temps, qui a régné quelques temps sur le Danemark et la Suède...

1.title: FR - Vikings - S01E01 - Rites of Passage
1.plot: Farmer, family man and rebel Ragnar Lothbrok is determined to sail west to discover new lands and riches despite an intimidating warning from his village's tyrannical leader, Lord Haraldson, who makes it clear in no uncertain terms that doing so could result in severe consequences.

1.title: FR - Vikings - S01E02 - Wrath of the Northmen
1.plot: The journey west begins as Ragnar gathers a crew willing to risk their lives to travel into the unknown. Earl Haraldson's paranoia reaches new heights as his fear of Ragnar's success grows.

1.title: FR - Vikings - S01E03 - Dispossessed
1.plot: Ragnar and his crew return from their trip with treasure, and Earl Haraldson has no choice but to sanction another raid. The west is open for the taking, and the Vikings' world will never be the same.

1.title: FR - Vikings - S01E04 - Trial
1.plot: Ragnar and his crew sail out with Earl Haraldson's permission.

1.title: FR - Vikings - S01E05 - Raid
1.plot: A seer reads Earl Haraldson's future and tells him that Ragnar searches for his death.

1.title: FR - Vikings - S01E06 - Burial of the Dead
1.plot: Ragnar, weak and still hurt, must meet the Earl head-on after it comes to light that Rollo has been tortured on Haraldson’s orders. The two men will come together face to face with a single outcome possible: Only one man will leave this fight alive.

1.title: FR - Vikings - S01E07 - A King's Ransom
1.plot: Three Viking ships sail toward the Royal Villa of King Aelle in eastern England. Ragnar wants ransom in exchange for peace, but the king has a very different plan in mind.

1.title: FR - Vikings - S01E08 - Sacrifice
1.plot: The traditional pilgrimage to Uppsala to thank the gods brings a torrent of emotions for Ragnar, Lagertha, and Athelstan. Ragnar, pulling farther away from his wife goes to make peace with the death of his unborn son. Lagertha, still reeling from her miscarriage, wants to find out from the gods if more sons are in her future. As the Vikings come together to sacrifice and give thanks to their gods, Athelstan discovers just how strong his Christian faith still is.

1.title: FR - Vikings - S01E09 - All Change
1.plot: Ragnar travels to Götaland to help King Horik resolve a land dispute with the area's leader, Jarl Borg. Meanwhile, sickness infects the village of Kattegat, and the people look to Lagertha to help them appease the gods.

2.title: FR - Vikings - S02E01 - Brother's War
2.plot: The battle begins between Ragnar and King Horik's forces against Jarl Borg; Princess Aslaug makes her way to Kattegat.

2.title: FR - Vikings - S02E02 - Invasion
2.plot: The time has come for an unlikely alliance to band together for a new raid on England; a storm pushes the Viking fleet to a new destination; Ragnar and his men may have met their match.

2.title: FR - Vikings - S02E03 - Treachery
2.plot: King Ecbert finds himself facing an entirely new kind of foe; Ragnar races to dominate in the west; Jarl Borg has his own plans in store for the future of Kattegat.

2.title: FR - Vikings - S02E04 - Eye for an Eye
2.plot: Ragnar and Ecbert come face to face; Jarl Borg rules Kattegat with an iron fist; Rollo must now become the leader his people need in Ragnar's absence.

2.title: FR - Vikings - S02E05 - Answers in Blood
2.plot: Lagertha and Ragnar unite to try to win Kattegat back from Jarl Borg; Aslaug must face the truth of her prophecies; Athelstan struggles to define his faith; Bjorn must once again make a choice.

2.title: FR - Vikings - S02E06 - Unforgiven
2.plot: King Horik returns to Kattegat with a surprising proposition for Ragnar; Lagertha runs into a less than enthusiastic homecoming from her new husband; Athelstan becomes confidant to King Ecbert.

2.title: FR - Vikings - S02E07 - Blood Eagle
2.plot: Ragnar and King Horik clash over how to dispense justice to Jarl Borg. In Wessex, King Aelle arrives and Ecbert has an eye on a new alliance.

2.title: FR - Vikings - S02E08 - Boneless
2.plot: Princess Aslaug's latest prophecy comes to fruition as she readies to give birth once more. Ragnar, Horik and their new ally Lagertha set sail for Wessex - Ragnar and Horik have very different ideas about the true purpose of this trip.

2.title: FR - Vikings - S02E09 - The Choice
2.plot: Ragnar's warriors march on to King Ecbert's villa and are met with a surprisingly vicious welcome party.

2.title: FR - Vikings - S02E10 - The Lord's Prayer
2.plot: Ragnar and King Horik return to Kattegat; Ragnar places his trust in those who have stood by him.

3.title: FR - Vikings - S03E01 - Mercenary
3.plot: Ragnar and Lagertha's fleets depart Kattegat once more for Wessex and this time they bring a group to colonize there. King Ecbert hosts the Norsemen and proposes a deal. Despite the misgivings of some of the other leaders, Ragnar leads his forces into battle once more, but this time as allies of Wessex.

3.title: FR - Vikings - S03E02 - The Wanderer
3.plot: Lagertha and Athelstan help to set up the Viking settlement. A mysterious wanderer arrives in Kattegat.

3.title: FR - Vikings - S03E03 - Warrior's Fate
3.plot: King Ecbert visits the developing Viking settlement as the first harvest is sown.

3.title: FR - Vikings - S03E04 - Scarred
3.plot: There is bitterness in the camp, Floki is angry over the alliance with Ecbert.

3.title: FR - Vikings - S03E05 - The Usurper
3.plot: The fleet returns to Kattegat to discover tragic circumstances await.

3.title: FR - Vikings - S03E06 - Born Again
3.plot: Preparations for the Paris raid pick up speed, and Rollo thinks about the Seer's prophecy.

3.title: FR - Vikings - S03E07 - Paris
3.plot: The Viking fleet causes panic in Paris. The Emperor Charles declares he will remain in the city.

3.title: FR - Vikings - S03E08 - To the Gates!
3.plot: The Viking army sets out and Paris goes into lockdown as the army prepares the defense.

3.title: FR - Vikings - S03E09 - Breaking Point
3.plot: Paris is hit with a second assault. Emperor Charles needs to make a difficult decision.

3.title: FR - Vikings - S03E10 - The Dead
3.plot: With one last chance to take Paris, Ragnar, and his Vikings troops take a daring chance. Ragnar asks Bjorn for a favor that could change the course of Viking history.

4.title: FR - Vikings - S04E01 - A Good Treason
4.plot: A dangerously ill Ragnar returns to Kattegat, where his suspected death kicks off a scramble to succeed him. Meanwhile, Lagertha engages in a power struggle with her calculating, former second in command, Kalf. Rollo betrays his heritage and remains in Frankia. Floki pays the price for his brutality against the Christian priest.

4.title: FR - Vikings - S04E02 - Kill the Queen
4.plot: As Ragnar and Floki remain at odds, Rollo makes great efforts in Paris to win over his new bride, Princess Gisla. Meanwhile, King Ecbert sets the task for his son Aethelwulf to rescue Queen Kwenthrith.

4.title: FR - Vikings - S04E03 - Mercy
4.plot: Floki learns of the heavy price he has paid for his actions. Rollo finds an unlikely ally in Count Odo. Bjorn has to fight a fierce opponent in the wilderness.

4.title: FR - Vikings - S04E04 - Yol
4.plot: King Aelle goes to Wessex for Christmas and is not impressed with how family relations are developing. Rollo's future hangs in the balance.

4.title: FR - Vikings - S04E05 - Promised
4.plot: There's an air of betrayal as those whom Odo trusts plot against him. Ecbert agrees to support Kwenthrith in Mercia. Pregnancy brings happiness to Lagertha and Kalf and a marriage is arranged.

4.title: FR - Vikings - S04E06 - What Might Have Been
4.plot: Ragnar declares another raid on Paris at the Thing in Kattegat. Ecbert also has a journey in mind as he dispatches Aethelwulf and Alfred on a pilgrimage to Rome.

4.title: FR - Vikings - S04E07 - The Profit and the Loss
4.plot: In England, King Ecbert's true ambitions are revealed as he plots to gain the crown of Mercia. The Vikings attack Paris with considerable force, but will Rollo's defenses be too much for them to overcome? Meanwhile, Harbard, the mysterious wanderer, returns and causes a stir amongst the women of Kattegat.

4.title: FR - Vikings - S04E08 - Portage
4.plot: Defeat for the Vikings calls Ragnar's leadership into question as they evacuate their camp and move back down river. Ragnar remains inscrutable until he orders the fleet to beach at a cliff face and unveils an ingenious plan. Rollo and Gisla have news that strengthens Rollo's position at the French Court.

4.title: FR - Vikings - S04E09 - Death All 'Round
4.plot: The labors of the Vikings eventually bear fruit as, within sight of Paris, they re-launch their boats but this time along with some interesting structures that Floki has built. Aethelwulf and Alfred eventually arrive in Rome and honors are conferred by Pope Leo but relations are not so cordial in Wessex between King Ecbert and the disgruntled King Aelle.

4.title: FR - Vikings - S04E10 - The Last Ship
4.plot: A ferocious battle between the Vikings and the French eventually comes down to Ragnar against Rollo. The outcome will seal the fate of the two brothers.

4.title: FR - Vikings - S04E11 - The Outsider
4.plot: Ragnar returns to Kattegat and formulates a plan to head back to Wessex, where he intends to right past wrongs.. Meanwhile, Lagertha plans a power play in Kattegat and Bjorn prepares to fulfill his long-held dream to explore the Mediterranean in a sleek new boat built for him by Floki.

4.title: FR - Vikings - S04E12 - The Vision
4.plot: The Kattegat locals chide Ragnar that the gods have deserted him as he struggles to crew his voyage to Wessex. It's Bjorn who has charisma now as he prepares to fulfill his long-held dream to explore the Mediterranean in a sleek new boat built for him by Floki. By contrast, Ragnar must accept weathered boats and a crew he has bribed but when Aslaug foresees that the fleet will be lost in a vicious storm her warnings go un-heeded by Ragnar and her precious son, Ivar.

4.title: FR - Vikings - S04E13 - Two Journeys
4.plot: Ragnar's fleet is shipwrecked and washes up on the Wessex coast, but without enough survivors to form a credible force, Ragnar and Ivar have a difficult decision to make. Rollo meets his Viking comrades again and can't resist the urge to join Bjorn's voyage, risking his marriage and his new Frankish identity. Ragnar too is taking a risk as he carries Ivar towards the Royal Villa in Wessex – throwing himself and his son upon the mercy of King Ecbert.

4.title: FR - Vikings - S04E14 - In the Uncertain Hour Before the Morning
4.plot: Ragnar's faith is tested.

4.title: FR - Vikings - S04E15 - All His Angels
4.plot: Ragnar's fate is decided.

4.title: FR - Vikings - S04E16 - Crossings
4.plot: Bjorn's fleet sails onward and launches a surprise attack. Back in Kattegat, Lagertha continues in her quest for power.

4.title: FR - Vikings - S04E17 - The Great Army
4.plot: The Viking army begins to gather in Kattegat. Lagertha must remain vigilant in the absence of her son, Bjorn.

4.title: FR - Vikings - S04E18 - Revenge
4.plot: Ragnar's plan comes to fruition. The Viking army lands on the coast of Northumbria.

4.title: FR - Vikings - S04E19 - On the Eve
4.plot: The Viking army causes panic in the English countryside as King Ecbert and Aethelwulf plan the defense of the realm.

4.title: FR - Vikings - S04E20 - The Reckoning
4.plot: Prince Aethelwulf finds himself subject to the Vikings' battle master plan. Ecbert remains behind with a plan of his own.

5.title: FR - Vikings - S05E01 - The Departed (1)
5.plot: Tensions mount between the sons of Ragnar Lothbrok as the Vikings continue to threaten the very heart of England. As the Great Army moves to take York, with King Aethelwulf and his family still in hiding, Heahmund—the warrior bishop—must rally the Saxons to defend the Realm.

5.title: FR - Vikings - S05E02 - The Departed (2)
5.plot: Tensions mount between the sons of Ragnar Lothbrok as the Vikings continue to threaten the very heart of England. As the Great Army moves to take York, with King Aethelwulf and his family still in hiding, Heahmund—the warrior bishop—must rally the Saxons to defend the Realm.

5.title: FR - Vikings - S05E03 - Homeland
5.plot: Celebrations are cut short in the aftermath of the battle at York. Ragnar Lothbrok's sons are pitted against each other as tensions reach an all-time high, and each is forced to choose a side.

5.title: FR - Vikings - S05E04 - The Plan
5.plot: Guided by Heahmund's visions, the Saxons devise a battle plan. Ivar the Boneless strategises as the Vikings undergo increasing pressure. Bjorn Ironside finds himself in a new territory and must convince the local commander he is a trader.

5.title: FR - Vikings - S05E05 - The Prisoner
5.plot: Ivar meets his match in Heahmund. Floki returns to Kattegat. Bjorn receives a lavish welcome in North Africa.

5.title: FR - Vikings - S05E06 - The Message
5.plot: Lagertha is betrayed, and Bjorn must find a way to support the distraught queen. Floki and his settlers arrive in a new land, but it is far from what they expected.

5.title: FR - Vikings - S05E07 - Full Moon
5.plot: Bjorn returns to Kattegat to learn that an attack will take place during the next full moon. Ivar must decide if he can place his trust in a former enemy on the battlefield.

5.title: FR - Vikings - S05E08 - The Joke
5.plot: The battle for Kattegat begins and, as the two armies line up to fight, the Great Heathen Army must decide between a final plea for peace or all-out war. Floki faces discord among the settlers.

5.title: FR - Vikings - S05E09 - A Simple Story
5.plot: The army leaders consider their options in the aftermath of the battle. In Floki's camp, all hopes of binding the community together are dashed as tragedy unfolds.

5.title: FR - Vikings - S05E10 - Moments of Vision
5.plot: A sense of doom looms over Kattegat as bloodshed ensues. The defeated army flees in the face of the victors. A legendary warrior makes his way home.

5.title: FR - Vikings - S05E11 - The Revelation
5.plot: Ivar is crowned the new king of Kattegat just in time to welcome Rollo home. Bjorn, Lagertha and Ubbe must rely on unsteady alliances to survive.

5.title: FR - Vikings - S05E12 - Murder Most Foul
5.plot: Bjorn, Lagertha and Ubbe face an uncertain fate as Heahmund's loyalty is tested. Floki fights to understand the will of the gods. Ivar may have met his match.

5.title: FR - Vikings - S05E13 - A New God
5.plot: Heahmund must try to convince King Alfred that his actions are in defense of the Crown. Ubbe and Torvi strengthen the position of the Vikings but not all in the Viking camp support their strategy. Another settler disappears in Iceland.

5.title: FR - Vikings - S05E14 - The Lost Moment
5.plot: As the celebrations for Ivar continue in Kattegat, grief hits Iceland and Floki must now make a fated decision. Harald's army approaches Wessex. A conspiracy grows against King Alfred.

5.title: FR - Vikings - S05E15 - Hell
5.plot: Bishop Heahmund is wracked with guilt as he fights to renounce his passions. Viking will clash with Saxon on the battlefield leaving a key figure lost in the balance.

5.title: FR - Vikings - S05E16 - The Buddha
5.plot: Bjorn achieves one of Ragnar's dreams. Ivar hatches a new plan while preparing for a divine arrival. In Iceland, a settler returns in a terrible state. King Alfred faces his greatest threat yet.

5.title: FR - Vikings - S05E17 - The Most Terrible Thing
5.plot: An unexpected turn amongst the settlers leaves Floki powerless. King Alfred confronts Judith. In York, Bjorn must strike a deal with Harald. Wessex is once again threatened by a Viking force, but who will lead the Saxon army to defend the Realm?

5.title: FR - Vikings - S05E18 - Baldur
5.plot: Hvitserk is severely tested. Floki makes an amazing discovery. Freydis gives Ivar a surprise. Ubbe negotiates with the three Danish Kings that have massed their armies in Reading, but the negotiations may have a perilous outcome.

5.title: FR - Vikings - S05E19 - What Happens in the Cave
5.plot: Ubbe is forced into hand-to-hand combat. Floki reaches new depths and is met by a shocking sight. Bjorn sets off for Scandinavia with an old rival.

5.title: FR - Vikings - S05E20 - Ragnarok
5.plot: A new battle for Kattegat is on and only the gods know who will emerge victorious.

6.title: FR - Vikings - S06E01 - New Beginnings
6.plot: It’s six months after the battle of Kattegat and Bjorn is now King. As he struggles with the responsibilities of kingship, he finds he can’t rely on his mother. Ivar falls into the hands of the Kievan Rus, and in their ruthless and unpredictable ruler, Prince Oleg, he may finally have met his match.

6.title: FR - Vikings - S06E02 - The Prophet
6.plot: Messengers arrive in Kattegat with news that presents Bjorn with a dilemma. Prince Oleg of Kiev seems untroubled by his conscience. Lagertha has settled into her new, peaceful life, but danger lurks nearby.

6.title: FR - Vikings - S06E03 - Ghosts, Gods and Running Dogs
6.plot: Lagertha is forced to take action. In Kiev, although Oleg continues to be friendly, Ivar is aware of the threat which Oleg poses to the vulnerable young heir to the throne. Bjorn has answered the call and come to the aid of an old enemy.

6.title: FR - Vikings - S06E04 - All the Prisoners
6.plot: Lagertha leads her village's response to the recent attacks, but despite her best efforts, the consequences are tragic. Olaf has a bold new plan for the future of Norway. Ivar discusses Oleg's ambitions for Scandinavia.

6.title: FR - Vikings - S06E05 - The Key
6.plot: As Norway’s Kings and Jarls arrive at Harald’s territory for the election of the King of all Norway, Olaf is certain of the result, however, it may not go as smoothly as he believes. Lagertha’s village is anxious in anticipation of another attack and she is relieved when Gunnhild arrives with re-enforcements. In Kiev, Igor and Ivar engage in subterfuge and Ivar is stunned when he encounters a ghost from his past.

6.title: FR - Vikings - S06E06 - Death and the Serpent
6.plot: Bjorn is forced to act quickly in the aftermath of the election for the king of all Norway. The Bandits attack Lagertha’s village again confident of an easy victory. However, when the defense boils down to single combat with Lagertha, victory seems less likely. In Kattegat, haunted and paranoid, Hvitserk continues to unravel.

6.title: FR - Vikings - S06E07 - The Ice Maiden
6.plot: Bjorn returns to Kattegat. Harald gains a measure of revenge on Olaf. In Kiev, interesting news reaches Ivar and Igor about Prince Dir.

6.title: FR - Vikings - S06E08 - Valhalla Can Wait
6.plot: Bjorn faces a difficult decision. Ubbe and Torvi leave Kattegat in search of new lands and perhaps old friends. Oleg's plans for the invasion of Scandinavia take shape. King Harald is baffled by the origin of a mysterious raiding party.

6.title: FR - Vikings - S06E09 - Resurrection
6.plot: In Iceland, Ubbe and Torvi finally meet a mysterious wanderer. Bjorn is forced to re-think who his enemies are when Erik returns from a scouting mission with worrying information. Bjorn will need allies, but he may not be able to convince his old foe, King Harald, to join forces in the face of the new threat. Ivar is reunited with someone close to him.

6.title: FR - Vikings - S06E10 - The Best Laid Plans
6.plot: Ivar and Igor may be plotting against Oleg, but they're still part of the force that departs Kiev to invade Scandinavia. King Harald and King Bjorn begin furious preparations for the invasion.

6.title: FR - Vikings - S06E11 - King of Kings
6.plot: In Iceland, Ubbe learns the truth about Kjetill and has a difficult decision to make. Back in Norway, the battle against the Rus has had grave consequences. But re-enforcements have arrived, and Bjorn has an idea that may yet save the day.

6.title: FR - Vikings - S06E12 - All Change
6.plot: Ubbe persuades the settlers in Iceland to embark on a voyage of exploration. The defeat of the Rus creates power vacuums in both Kattegat and Kiev.

6.title: FR - Vikings - S06E13 - The Signal
6.plot: The election for Kattegat's new ruler is held, but a surprise visitor disrupts the proceedings. Ivar puts his plan to overthrow Oleg into action.

6.title: FR - Vikings - S06E14 - Lost Souls
6.plot: As his enemies scheme for power, Harald prepares for his coronation and chooses a queen. Ubbe's party reaches shore — but not the one they're seeking.

6.title: FR - Vikings - S06E15 - All at Sea
6.plot: Factions in Greenland spill blood, driving Ubbe's company away. Troops under Ivar and Dir seize Kiev for Prince Igor. Gunnhild makes a fateful choice.

6.title: FR - Vikings - S06E16 - The Final Straw
6.plot: Ubbe and his followers languish on the open sea. Ivar and Hvitserk receive a frosty reception in Kattegat, until a restless Ivar has a revelation.

6.title: FR - Vikings - S06E17 - The Raft of Medusa
6.plot: Ivar and Hvitserk lead King Harald's army to England, where King Alfred of Wessex abandons his royal villa and marches to meet the sons of Ragnar.

6.title: FR - Vikings - S06E18 - It's Only Magic
6.plot: King Alfred falls ill as the Viking army seizes the high ground. Ingrid curses Erik. Ubbe and his people find a new world — but they're not alone.

6.title: FR - Vikings - S06E19 - The Lord Giveth...
6.plot: Ubbe and the settlers open relations with the indigenous people of the new land. Ivar's strategy lures Alfred's forces into a devastating battle.

6.title: FR - Vikings - S06E20 - The Last Act
6.plot: Ubbe reunites with an old friend but must pass judgment on a killer. The armies of Alfred and Ivar clash as each leader looks to his god for strength.

meta.plot: Qui n’a jamais rêvé - ou plutôt cauchemardé - qu’il repassait son bac ? Étape essentielle de notre vie et premier VRAI examen de notre futur d’adulte. Ce petit mais néanmoins primordial diplôme qui nous permettra d’aller plus loin. Et pourtant, certains n’ont pas leur bac. Nombreuses sont les raisons : difficultés sociales, familiales, raisons de santé, parcours de vie chaotique, décrochage…

meta.plot: This docuseries follows the rise and fall of financier Bernie Madoff, who orchestrated one of the biggest Ponzi schemes in Wall Street history.

1.title: EN - Madoff: The Monster of Wall Street [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E01 - A Liar, Not a Failure
1.plot: Starting his career in penny stock trades, Bernie Madoff builds a lucrative side business as an adviser, attracting clients with impressive returns.

1.title: EN - Madoff: The Monster of Wall Street [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E02 - Don't Ask, Don't Tell
1.plot: As word of Madoff's seemingly golden touch spreads from Wall Street to Palm Beach, his empire branches out into hedge funds — and draws scrutiny.

1.title: EN - Madoff: The Monster of Wall Street [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E03 - See No Evil
1.plot: Competitors investigate Madoff's impossible numbers and alert the Securities and Exchange Commission, but the agency shrugs off multiple red flags.

1.title: EN - Madoff: The Monster of Wall Street [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E04 - The Price of Trust
1.plot: Madoff’s scheme is exposed amid the 2008 financial market crisis. His victims' lives are upended as they face years of obstacles to recoup their losses.

1.title: FR - La Reine du flow - S01E01 - Episode 1
1.plot: Talented songwriter Yeimy plots revenge against those who put her in prison. She recalls her high school crush Charly, who's now a famous singer.

1.title: FR - La Reine du flow - S01E02 - Episode 2
1.plot: Teenage Yeimy mourns her loss. Soul and Bass raise money by putting on their first concert. To prove himself to his uncle, Charly accepts a risky job.

1.title: FR - La Reine du flow - S01E03 - Episode 3
1.plot: After Yeimy confronts Charly about what he's done, he takes advantage of her feelings for him, and comes up with a plan so his uncle won't kill her.

1.title: FR - La Reine du flow - S01E04 - Episode 4
1.plot: When Juancho refuses to believe Yeimy is guilty, Charly tries to convince him otherwise. In prison, Yeimy receives a threat, followed by shocking news.

1.title: FR - La Reine du flow - S01E05 - Episode 5
1.plot: After visiting Yeimy in the U.S., her grandmother returns home to a nasty surprise. Years later, Charly wonders about his adopted brother's parentage.

1.title: FR - La Reine du flow - S01E06 - Episode 6
1.plot: Juancho mourns Yeimy's supposed death as she arrives in Puerto Rico and begins training for her undercover work as music producer Tamy.

1.title: FR - La Reine du flow - S01E07 - Episode 7
1.plot: Her training complete, Yeimy returns to Medellín for the first time in 17 years and finally comes face to face with Charly. Erik enters a music battle.

1.title: FR - La Reine du flow - S01E08 - Episode 8
1.plot: Yeimy reunites with an unsuspecting Juancho. Vanesa gets approached by a talent scout for modeling. Charly tries to win over a critical reporter.

1.title: FR - La Reine du flow - S01E09 - Episode 9
1.plot: Yeimy attends the next "cockfight" to find new talent. Charly performs a concert with reggaeton star Sebastián Yatra and debuts Yeimy's new song.

1.title: FR - La Reine du flow - S01E10 - Episode 10
1.plot: The modeling agent pressures Vanesa to expand her personal boundaries. Yeimy brings a young new singer to Charly, and later tries to bug his office.

1.title: FR - La Reine du flow - S01E11 - Episode 11
1.plot: Vanesa tells her parents about her new job. Erik runs away from home after a fight with Charly. Juancho is forced to work for Excelsior Studios.

1.title: FR - La Reine du flow - S01E12 - Episode 12
1.plot: Erik looks for answers about his birth parents. Yeimy and Juancho collaborate to produce Cris's first track. Gema suspects Charly is still seeing Zulma.

1.title: FR - La Reine du flow - S01E13 - Episode 13
1.plot: Yeimy releases an incriminating video of Charly and Zulma, but in trying to ruin his career, she also ends up impacting his daughter, Vanesa.

1.title: FR - La Reine du flow - S01E14 - Episode 14
1.plot: Erik gets an anonymous offer that spurs him to secretly record an album with Yeimy and Juancho. Charly works on repairing his image and relationships.

1.title: FR - La Reine du flow - S01E15 - Episode 15
1.plot: When the DEA goes after Manín, Charly gets caught in the crossfire. Yeimy tries to get Vanesa to open up to her, and gives Gema PR advice.

1.title: FR - La Reine du flow - S01E16 - Episode 16
1.plot: Erik finds out the name of his birth mother. Yeimy tries to get closer to Gema. Charly returns home and is determined to find the mole.

1.title: FR - La Reine du flow - S01E17 - Episode 17
1.plot: Charly tasks Axl with reviewing the security footage. Lucio follows Carrancho to a phone booth. Cata's growing suspicions about Yeimy annoy Juancho.

1.title: FR - La Reine du flow - S01E18 - Episode 18
1.plot: Erik meets the informant's go-between at the park. Ligia reaches her limit with Manín. Juancho and Yeimy fight over her relationship with Charly.

1.title: FR - La Reine du flow - S01E19 - Episode 19
1.plot: Erik learns who his informant was. Gema seeks another man's attentions. Charly pays a surprise visit to Yeimy's home. Vanesa and Silvana go to a party.

1.title: FR - La Reine du flow - S01E20 - Episode 20
1.plot: The accident has devastating repercussions. Yeimy spots an opportunity and calls Silvana's father. Jack declares to Yeimy his feelings for her.

1.title: FR - La Reine du flow - S01E21 - Episode 21
1.plot: Yeimy makes a comment that leads Juancho to doubt her identity. Vanesa becomes distraught when she hears Silvana's father speak to the press on TV.

1.title: FR - La Reine du flow - S01E22 - Episode 22
1.plot: Gema searches Vanesa's room to see if she's lying about using drugs only once. Juancho contacts the musicians shown in photos with Yeimy on her website.

1.title: FR - La Reine du flow - S01E23 - Episode 23
1.plot: Juancho confronts Yeimy with his suspicions about who she really is. Vanesa argues with her parents after they reveal their plans for her.

1.title: FR - La Reine du flow - S01E24 - Episode 24
1.plot: Juancho argues with Yeimy about her vengefulness. Charly grows suspicious of Yeimy and Juancho and has her followed. Vanesa's family goes to therapy.

1.title: FR - La Reine du flow - S01E25 - Episode 25

meta.plot: Après avoir passé 17 ans derrière les barreaux à tort, une musicienne talentueuse décide de se venger de ceux qui ont entraîné sa chute et tué sa famille.
A dedicated customs officer and his team take on a notorious smuggler leading a powerful syndicate, but unexpected obstacles threaten their mission.

1.title: EN - Taskaree: The Smuggler's Web [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E01 - Customs vs Popat
1.plot: Amid mounting pressure to curb smuggling at Mumbai airport, officer Prakash Kumar takes charge and ends Arjun Meena's suspension so he can lead the team.

1.title: EN - Taskaree: The Smuggler's Web [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E02 - Bada Choudhary
1.plot: Arjun forms his A-Team with formerly suspended officers Mitali and Ravinder, as Prakash tasks them with taking down the Bada Choudhary syndicate.

1.title: EN - Taskaree: The Smuggler's Web [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E03 - The Priya Story
1.plot: Caught smuggling gold by Arjun, flight attendant Priya goes undercover for him. The World Customs Conference offers a chance to trap the smugglers.

1.title: EN - Taskaree: The Smuggler's Web [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E04 - Operation Longshot
1.plot: The customs team mounts a large-scale sting to intercept gold smugglers converging on Mumbai. Bada Choudhary senses something is wrong.

1.title: EN - Taskaree: The Smuggler's Web [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E05 - Hum Coin Hain
1.plot: Prakash is sent to Bangkok, where he meets an unexpected visitor. The search of a suspect's home leads the officers to a troubling incident.

1.title: EN - Taskaree: The Smuggler's Web [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E06 - Darr Ka Dhandha
1.plot: The Choudhary syndicate strikes back with violence and intimidation against the customs officers. Ravinder's reckless move drags him deeper into trouble.

1.title: EN - Taskaree: The Smuggler's Web [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E07 - Kahani Khatam
1.plot: Arjun gets crucial information from Srikant Saxena. As the syndicate tries one final gold smuggling run, can the officers stop them before it's too late?

meta.plot: Fièvre printanière : cette lassitude qui gagne souvent les gens au printemps. Yoon Bom, une professeure au cœur en hiver, rejoint une petite école de campagne où elle réapprend doucement le bonheur au contact chaleureux de Sun Jae-gyu.

1.title: FR - Fièvre printanière - S01E01 - Your Uncle Is That Guy
1.plot: In the small seaside town of Shinsu-eup, where the villagers closely monitor each other's every move, Yoon Bom is a figure who carries a question mark. Speculation abounds as to how Yoon Bom, once a successful teacher in Seoul, ended up in this town... But one figure boasts an overwhelming presence that instantly steals all their attention: Seon Jae-gyu, the townspeople's number one target of vigilance. When Bom enters his radar, her monotonous daily life begins to unravel!

1.title: FR - Fièvre printanière - S01E02 - Your Uncle Has A Job
1.plot: There's something familiar about Jae Gyu's actions, though Bom can't quite figure out why. Meanwhile, Se Jin disappears, frustrated from always coming in second because of Han Gyeol. Bom and Jae Gyu head to Seoul to find her. At a critical moment, Jae Gyu's sudden appearance flips a switch in Bom's memory.

1.title: FR - Fièvre printanière - S01E03 - Your Uncle Is A Dad
1.plot: Bom glimpses an unexpected side of Jae-gyu and starts to think he might not be so bad after all. Then a shocking rumor begins spreading through town: Jae-gyu isn't Han-gyul's uncle, he's his dad! The news keeps weighing on her, so she decides to confront it head-on.

1.title: FR - Fièvre printanière - S01E04 - Your Uncle Is An Heir
1.plot: Bom's heart freezes over again when she realizes Jae-gyu knows her secrets. She throws up a cold wall and tells him to stay out of her life. Determined to clear up the misunderstanding, Jae-gyu brings out his ultimate move to win her back. Will it be enough to thaw Bom's heart?

1.title: FR - Fièvre printanière - S01E05 - Your Uncle Is Not Participating
1.plot: Shinsu-eup's biggest festival, the Shinsu High School Sports Festival, is underway. However, Jae-gyu, unaware that Bom has been transferred to the Baek team, declares his withdrawal. Without Jae-gyu, the Baek team struggles to muster, and Bom's face fills with dejection . Jae-gyu's inability to compete in order to keep his promise to Han-gyeol is beyond words. Bom visits Jae-gyu and offers words that fuel his yearning!

1.title: FR - Fièvre printanière - S01E06 - Your Uncle Is A Thief
1.plot: Bom admits to her feelings for Jaegyu, but refuses to meet with his parents any longer. Jaegyu declares to her that he will wait until Hangyeol graduates. Until then, they agree to maintain a strictly public distance. However, contrary to their firm promise, their jealousy towards each other only grows...!

1.title: FR - Fièvre printanière - S01E07 - Episode 7
1.plot: The misunderstanding between them has been resolved, but perhaps it was after their accidental kiss? The fact that they have to wait until Han-gyeol's graduation is disappointing and regrettable. Ultimately, they agree to a one-day date before officially entering into a relationship. Will their secret date go smoothly?

1.title: FR - Fièvre printanière - S01E08 - Your Uncle... Collapsed?
