meta.plot: À la fin du premier millénaire, les guerriers les plus forts et les plus cruels de leur temps se sont répandus à travers le monde entier : les Vikings. Thorfinn, le fils de l’homme réputé comme étant le plus fort des guerriers, décide de passer sa vie sur les champs de batailles malgré son jeune âge tout en rêvant d’atteindre le légendaire continent que l’on appelle « Vinland ». Dans le tourbillon d’une époque troublée, la saga d’un vrai guerrier commence.

1.title: FR - Vinland Saga - S01E01 - Somewhere Not Here
1.plot: Thorfinn, a boy living in Iceland, longs for adventure and is eager to know more about the world. He dreams of a land of paradise called Vinland that he hears about from the adventurer Leif, while he leads his peaceful life with this father Thors, a former warrior. One day, Thors saves a runaway slave and sets a series of events in motion. This is the story of a true warrior in an age of turmoil.

1.title: FR - Vinland Saga - S01E02 - Sword
1.plot: In the year 1002, the war between England and Denmark was intensifying. One day, the Jomsvikings pay a visit to Thorfinn's village in order to bring back Thors, their former commander, to prepare for the impending battle. Thors is forced to join the war in order to protect the villagers from being taken hostage, and must face his accursed past in order to save his family and his village.

1.title: FR - Vinland Saga - S01E03 - Troll
1.plot: Askeladd, the leader of a Viking army of a hundred men, receives orders from Floki of the Jomsvikings to kill Thors, who was once known as the Troll of Jom. However, the villagers, completely unaware of the order, buzz with excitement as they prepare for their first battle. Thorfinn also joins in the excitement. Thors and his men are about to embark on a difficult sea journey to England.

1.title: FR - Vinland Saga - S01E04 - A True Warrior
1.plot: Thors and his men fall for Askeladd's trap and faces a dangerous situation, but Thors defeats many of Askeladd's men with his overpowering strength. However, Thors knows that it will be difficult to save everyone, including his son, who've been living in a peaceful village their entire lives, and makes a tough decision.

1.title: FR - Vinland Saga - S01E05 - The Troll's Son
1.plot: After Askeladd kills Thorfinn's father Thors, Thorfinn hides inside Thor's ship and bides his time until the opportunity to take revenge. However, life on the ship is harsh without any food or water, and Thorfinn grows weaker day by day. One day, Thorfinn, armed with his sword, attempt to attack Askeladd in his sleep...

1.title: FR - Vinland Saga - S01E06 - The Journey Begins
1.plot: Thorfinn kills his first man. As more time goes on Thorfinn kills more men and becomes more skilled. One day when Thorfinn is in battle he gets shot with an arrow and ends up unconscious. An English woman and her daughter help him recover.

1.title: FR - Vinland Saga - S01E07 - Normanni
1.plot: Askeladd withdraws temporarily from the war against England. While searching for a new source of income, he encounters a skirmish among the Franks and hatches a plot to steal their treasure. Askeladd sends 16 years old Thorfinn, who has grown up into a cold-hearted Viking, ahead as a messenger.

1.title: FR - Vinland Saga - S01E08 - Beyond the Edge of the Sea
1.plot: After capturing the treasure from the Franks, Askeladd's men return to the village of Gorm on the Jutland Peninsula in Denmark to pass the winter. Thorfinn challenges Askeladd to a duel as a reward for bringing him the head of the captain of the clan of Franks. Even though Thorfinn has grown in skill through his experience in battle, he is still no match for Askeladd.

1.title: FR - Vinland Saga - S01E09 - The Battle of London Bridge
1.plot: In October 1013, King Sweyn leads a fleet of Danish and Viking ships in an attempt to take London Bridge of England. Askeladd's army, hired by the army of Denmark, was among them. However, after the betrayal of Thorkell the Tall, a Viking known for his overpowering strength, London Bridge has become impregnable. Askeladd tells Thorfinn he'll reward him with a duel if he's able to kill Thorkell.

1.title: FR - Vinland Saga - S01E10 - Ragnarok
1.plot: Askeladd's army separates from the army of Denmark and attacks a village 100 km to the west. Thorfinn leaves the soldiers behind in disgust and climbs up a hill overlooking the village, where he pledges revenge for his father. However, he encounters Askeladd sitting in the darkness, who tells him about "Britannia", the aging of the world, and Ragnarok, the final battle.

1.title: FR - Vinland Saga - S01E11 - A Gamble
1.plot: Thorkell takes Canute hostage and follows after the main army of Denmark. Ragnar objects to Thorkell’s plan to take on the entire army of Denmark, boasting 16,000 soldiers, with only 500 men. Thorkell then begins to tell Ragnar the story of Valhalla, the pride of Normans, a place where only those who die in battle can go.

1.title: FR - Vinland Saga - S01E12 - The Land on the Far Bank
1.plot: Askeladd and his men continue their march to escape from Thorkell. However, their march comes to a halt at the Severn River. Askeladd hands a letter to an old man operating a ferry across the river and tells him to deliver the letter to the other side immediately. As soon as he hears the addressee’s name, the old man sets off in his boat.

1.title: FR - Vinland Saga - S01E13 - Child of a Hero
1.plot: Askeladd crosses the river and escapes from Thorkell into Wales with Canute. However, Askeladd’s men are ambushed by a group of soldiers hiding behind the boulders at the border of the kingdom of Brycheiniog. Askeladd attempts to negotiate with their messenger and reveals his plan.

1.title: FR - Vinland Saga - S01E14 - The Light of Dawn
1.plot: Askeladd and his men change course and decide to return to Gainsborough, by crossing through the Earldom of Mercia in the midst of a harsh snowstorm, where the main army of Denmark awaits. The men spot a small village in the blizzard and make their move.

1.title: FR - Vinland Saga - S01E15 - After Yule
1.plot: After losing Canute, Thorkell decides to halt his advance in central England. Thorkell hears that the end of the war between Denmark and England is near, and bemoans the end of the war. However, he later gets wind of an interesting piece of news.

1.title: FR - Vinland Saga - S01E16 - History of Beasts
1.plot: Askeladd and his men are attacked by the English army in the village where they had planned to camp during the winter. Askeladd captures their captain and interrogates him to find out how the English knew where they were, and discovers that Thorkell is fast approaching. The news of Thorkell's arrival sends waves of shock among Askeladd's followers.

1.title: FR - Vinland Saga - S01E17 - Servant
1.plot: Askeladd's men continued their march to escape Thorkell. However, Torgrim and his friends were hatching a plot to switch sides and join Thorkell, taking Canute with them. Torgrim finally launches his rebellion and corners Askeladd, negotiating with him to hand over Canute, then Thorkell arrives in the midst of the confusion.

1.title: FR - Vinland Saga - S01E18 - Out of the Cradle
1.plot: Thorfinn and Thorkell agree to have a duel over the fate of Askeladd. Thorkell looks forward to facing off against Thors’s son, Thorfinn, and asks him what a true warrior really is. Meanwhile, Canute is suddenly ambushed while he attempts to escape, and has a dream about a certain individual.

1.title: FR - Vinland Saga - S01E19 - United Front
1.plot: Thorfinn suffers a serious injury in his fight against Thorkell. Thorfinn is told to think about what he has to do to beat Thorkell. Askeladd treats Thorfinn’s wounds so that he may fight again someday, and proposes a joint strategy to help the two of them survive longer.

1.title: FR - Vinland Saga - S01E20 - Crown
1.plot: Thorfinn suffers a serious injury in his fight against Thorkell. Thorfinn is told to think about what he has to do to beat Thorkell. Askeladd treats Thorfinn’s wounds so that he may fight again someday, and proposes a joint strategy to help the two of them survive longer.

1.title: FR - Vinland Saga - S01E21 - Reunion
1.plot: Canute’s party arrives in York to attend the Imperial Council. Although Canute had wanted to strike out against King Sweyn, the King was being guarded by the most powerful Jomsviking unit in the Northern Sea while keeping a close eye on Canute. With the situation strained to the breaking point, Askeladd comes up with a plan. Meanwhile, Thorfinn is reunited with a person who knew his former self.

1.title: FR - Vinland Saga - S01E22 - Lone Wolf
1.plot: Thorfinn begins his duel against Askeladd with Canute and Thorkell as witnesses. However, Thorfinn is unable to strike as he stands overwhelmed by the extraordinary mood that overtakes Askeladd after Bjorn's departure. Having noticed Thorfinn's hesitation, Askeladd lays down his sword and provokes Thorfinn into an unarmed fight, which incites Thorfinn's fury.

1.title: FR - Vinland Saga - S01E23 - Miscalculation
1.plot: After the assassination attempt on Canute’s life, rumors spread through York saying that the king is trying to kill Canute. As a result, the king is unable to issue any orders that would put Canute in harm, and Askeladd is pleased that everything is proceeding as planned. However, the tables turn when King Sweyn speaks. Meanwhile, Thorfinn is sent to prison as punishment for disturbing the peace.

1.title: FR - Vinland Saga - S01E24 - End of the Prologue
1.plot: Askeladd comes forth before King Sweyn and implores him to halt his invasion of Wales. Meanwhile, Thorfinn decides to return home at Leif’s urging. However, the moment before he boards the ship, Thorfinn catches a glimpse of a single tern taking off into the sky...

2.title: FR - Vinland Saga - S02E01 - Slave
2.plot: Einar lives peacefully in northern England with his mother and sister, but then one day, their village comes under attack.

2.title: FR - Vinland Saga - S02E02 - Ketil's Farm
2.plot: Einar and Thorfinn are told to convert a wild forest into a wheat field; and if they succeed, they will have the chance to buy their own freedom.

2.title: FR - Vinland Saga - S02E03 - Snake
2.plot: The farm guards convince Ketil’s 17-year-old son that he needs to make his first killing to become a man.

2.title: FR - Vinland Saga - S02E04 - Awakening
2.plot: After everything that happened, Einar asks Thorfinn if he's ever fought in a war — and if he's ever killed a man.

2.title: FR - Vinland Saga - S02E05 - Path of Blood
2.plot: After the sudden turn of events, young Canute must rise up to claim the throne to a kingdom much reduced and under attack.

2.plot: Thorfinn and Einar are working themselves to the bone to clear the forest, but there's only so much they can do without the help of horses.

2.plot: Thieves have been stealing food from Ketil's farm. Meanwhile, Ketil's eldest son Thorgil returns home.

2.plot: Thorfinn has nightmares almost every night, but he can never remember what he dreamed about — and that bothers him.

2.title: FR - Vinland Saga - S02E09 - Oath
2.plot: Thorfinn wakes up in a peaceful place and he sees his father again. But then things quickly turn dark, and Thorfinn must face his painful past.

2.title: FR - Vinland Saga - S02E10 - The Cursed Head
2.plot: Finally, after three long years, Einar and Thorfinn chop down the final tree in the forest. With hope in their hearts, they talk about the future.

2.plot: While in Jelling, Ketil, Thorgil and Olmar meet a man named Leif Erikson who is searching for Thorfinn, the son of his close friend.

2.plot: Olmar feels insulted by Canute's messenger and, encouraged by his older brother Thorgil, takes matters into his own hands.

2.plot: Einar says that even if he gains his freedom, he wants to stay near Arnheid. Snake hears news of a slave who killed his owners, and is now on the run.

2.title: FR - Vinland Saga - S02E17 - The Road Home
2.plot: Snake strikes quickly, surprising Thorfinn with his speed and agility. As he lies wounded, Gardar thinks back on the life he shared with Arnheid.

2.title: FR - Vinland Saga - S02E18 - The First Method
2.plot: After returning home to his farm, an exhausted Ketil starts searching for Arnheid, only to find out what happened in his absence.

2.title: FR - Vinland Saga - S02E19 - The Battle of Ketil's Farm
2.plot: Amidst the confusion of a peasant uprising, Thorfinn and the others try to escape, carrying a severely injured and pregnant Arnheid.

2.title: FR - Vinland Saga - S02E20 - Pain
2.plot: As Thorfinn and Einar head for their escape, Arnheid regains consciousness and asks where they are going — and if there are slaves and wars there, too.

2.title: FR - Vinland Saga - S02E21 - Courage
2.plot: The battle has left heartbreaking casualties in its wake. Though Thorgil and Ketil's wife want to continue the fight, Canute demands their surrender.

2.title: FR - Vinland Saga - S02E22 - The King of Rebellion
2.plot: Snake tries to put a stop to it, but Thorfinn insists on receiving all 100 blows from Canute's brutish guard Drott, shocking the rowdy onlookers.

2.title: FR - Vinland Saga - S02E23 - Two Paths
2.plot: Thorfinn and Einar have said their piece, but Canute stubbornly refuses to give up Ketil's Farm. Then, Thorfinn breaks the standoff with a decision.

2.title: FR - Vinland Saga - S02E24 - Home
2.plot: At long last, Thorfinn returns to Iceland and finds a moment of happiness, reunited with his loved ones. But soon, he opens up about his next journey.

1.title: FR - Marshals - S01E01 - Piya Wiconi

1.title: FR - Marshals - S01E02 - Zone of Death
1.plot: As Kayce tries to embrace his new beginning, a Marshals op to stop a domestic terror attack lands him in a valley of buried Dutton family skeletons. While confronting his past, he must also learn to ingratiate himself with his new Marshals teammates.

1.title: FR - Marshals - S01E03 - Road to Nowhere
1.plot: When a standoff between Broken Rock and local ranchers over a mine groundbreaking turns violent, the Marshals launch a manhunt to find the shooters.

1.title: FR - Marshals - S01E04 - The Gathering Storm
1.plot: Kayce and Cal search for survivors of a helicopter crash while the rest of the team tries to clear Kayce's name in a use of force complaint.

1.title: FR - Marshals - S01E05 - Lost Girls (1)
1.plot: When Kayce and Tate cross paths with an old friend of Tate's from the rez, Hayley, who exhibits behavior consistent with a trafficking victim, Kayce throws himself into tracking her down rather than committing to commemorating Monica.

1.title: FR - Marshals - S01E06 - Out of the Shadows (2)
1.plot: After losing the trail of teen trafficking victims, Kayce must tell Tate that his friend may be gone for good. When the Marshals learn the girls are in the hands of a violent motorcycle gang, they launch a dangerous op to infiltrate the gang.

1.title: FR - Marshals - S01E07 - Family Business
1.plot: When a federal judge and her family are the targets of a car bomb, the Marshals are assigned to guard them. Family secrets start to surface as the Marshals start to look into why someone would want this family dead.

1.title: FR - Marshals - S01E08 - Blowback
1.plot: The Marshals go manhunting after receiving a tip that a dangerous fugitive is on the loose. Kayce and Cal struggle to reckon with their time at war when a former SEAL brother, Garrett, drifts back into their lives as they hunt a vicious enemy.

meta.plot: Le ranch du Yellowstone derrière lui, Kayce Dutton rejoint une unité des U.S. Marhals. Cowboy et ancien Navy SEAL, il apporte la justice dans le Montana. Lui et ses coéquipiers sont le dernier rempart de la région dans la guerre contre la violence.
Un agent israélien sort de sa retraite pour traquer un militant palestinien qu'il pensait avoir tué, ce qui déclenche une série d'événements chaotiques.

1.title: FR - Fauda - S01E01 - Episode 1
1.plot: Discovering that Abu Ahmed will attend his brother's wedding, Doron joins his old team for a covert strike, but the plan quickly goes off the rails.

1.title: FR - Fauda - S01E02 - Episode 2
1.plot: Having tasted action again, Doron pleads with Moreno to rejoin the squad. Meanwhile, Amal determines to martyr herself to avenge her husband.

1.title: FR - Fauda - S01E03 - Episode 3
1.plot: Abu Ahmed leans on Walid to organize an immediate retaliatory attack, and Doron and Nurit go undercover to close in on their quarry.

1.title: FR - Fauda - S01E04 - Episode 4
1.plot: Doron sets his sights on recruiting Shirin to his cause. Abu Ahmed risks his life to see his wife, and Moreno sends the team on a daring daytime raid.

1.title: FR - Fauda - S01E05 - Episode 5
1.plot: A senior Israeli officer tries to smoke Abu Ahmed out of hiding. Ali fights suspicions of duplicity, and Boaz joins the squad on a risky ambush.

1.title: FR - Fauda - S01E06 - Episode 6
1.plot: Blamed for the disastrous ambush, Doron takes matters into his own hands and asks the team to join him on a mission to set things right.

1.title: FR - Fauda - S01E07 - Episode 7
1.plot: While Moreno tries to track down the rogue team, Doron sinks his hooks deeper into Shirin and takes drastic measures to make a prisoner exchange.

1.title: FR - Fauda - S01E08 - Episode 8
1.plot: In the wake of the prisoner exchange, Doron disappears. Walid confronts Abu Ahmed about his tactics, and Moreno's boss threatens to dissolve the team.

1.title: FR - Fauda - S01E09 - Episode 9
1.plot: While suspicions grow between Abu Ahmed and his inner circle, Doron poses as a would-be suicide bomber to get perilously close to his target.

1.title: FR - Fauda - S01E10 - Episode 10
1.plot: Doron gets a surprise visitor while waiting to learn his fate. Abu Ahmed lays out his master plan that could change the region's balance of power.

1.title: FR - Fauda - S01E11 - Episode 11
1.plot: Doron's bosses give him the go-ahead to carry out his plan, but he discovers the toll his family has paid for his obsession with Abu Ahmed.

1.title: FR - Fauda - S01E12 - Episode 12
1.plot: While the team scrambles to give Doron backup on his mission into the lion's den, Walid makes a decision that could change everything.

2.title: FR - Fauda - S02E01 - Episode 1
2.plot: Doron joins his old team for an operation to take out the mastermind behind a bombing attack -- and who also wants revenge against Doron himself.

2.title: FR - Fauda - S02E02 - Episode 2
2.plot: Tensions rise on both sides as Doron's team intensifies its hunt and Abu Samara hands Al Makdasi an ultimatum. Shirin faces tough questions.

2.title: FR - Fauda - S02E03 - Episode 3
2.plot: Rebuked by Walid, Al Makdasi doubles down on his renegade plan to exact revenge. Doron goes rogue during an operation to offer Shirin a way out.

2.title: FR - Fauda - S02E04 - Episode 4
2.plot: Nidal's plan takes an unexpected lethal turn and backs him into a corner. Shirin reaches out to Doron, putting them both at risk.

2.title: FR - Fauda - S02E05 - Episode 5
2.plot: Doron scrambles to protect his family when Nidal gets too close. Shirin puts a dangerous plan in motion. Walid learns some distressing news.

2.title: FR - Fauda - S02E06 - Episode 6
2.plot: Sensing a chance to strike, Nidal regroups and leads a nighttime raid. While Walid faces interrogation, Doron takes Shirin under his wing.

2.title: FR - Fauda - S02E07 - Episode 7
2.plot: Nidal defends his new allegiance to Samir. Captain Ayub blackmails Abu Samara into helping him lay a trap. Sagi's nerves jeopardize a mission.

2.title: FR - Fauda - S02E08 - Episode 8
2.plot: After discovering Nidal's true loyalties, Abu Maher joins in the effort to track him down. Captain Ayub and Naor escalate their plan to break Walid.

2.title: FR - Fauda - S02E09 - Episode 9
2.plot: With Doron grieving a loss, Shirin faces tough questions and the team carries out a rogue operation to get answers. Nidal sends Maher on a mission.

2.title: FR - Fauda - S02E10 - Episode 10
2.plot: Worried that Doron is sinking into despair, the team rallies to galvanize him to action. Samir confronts Nidal. Abu Maher makes a discovery.

2.title: FR - Fauda - S02E11 - Episode 11
2.plot: An operation to bring down Nidal backs the team into a lethal corner. Abu Maher makes a heartrending decision, and Captain Ayub learns critical intel.

2.title: FR - Fauda - S02E12 - Episode 12
2.plot: Doron faces a fresh threat as the scope of Nidal's unfolding plan becomes clear, while the team and Abu Samara move to intervene before time runs out.

3.title: FR - Fauda - S03E01 - Episode 1
3.plot: Doron goes undercover in a risky, months-long operation, but his mission takes a sharp turn when surprise intel points to an imminent attack.

3.title: FR - Fauda - S03E02 - Episode 2
3.plot: The search for Fauzi intensifies in the wake of the attack. Doron goes back undercover but faces heightened suspicion and scrutiny.

3.title: FR - Fauda - S03E03 - Episode 3
3.plot: Abu Mohammed gives Jihad a menacing ultimatum. A raid turns unexpectedly lethal. Doron pushes to extract Bashar to safety as the walls close in.

3.title: FR - Fauda - S03E04 - Episode 4
3.plot: Jihad and Nasser act when an impulsive decision sends Bashar deeper into jeopardy. Avihai faces tough questions about the raid. Hila opens up to Doron.

3.title: FR - Fauda - S03E05 - Episode 5
3.plot: With Doron and his team close on their heels, an increasingly desperate Bashar and Jihad follow an audacious plan to elude capture.

3.title: FR - Fauda - S03E06 - Episode 6
3.plot: As the search for the hostages intensifies, Hila turns to an old asset, and Doron's squad prepares for one of its riskiest covert operations yet.

3.title: FR - Fauda - S03E07 - Episode 7
3.plot: A hostage takes matters into his own hands, making the team's stealth mission even more urgent. Bashar learns the distressing truth about his situation.

3.title: FR - Fauda - S03E08 - Episode 8
3.plot: Saddled with a new responsibility, Jihad sees a chance to change his family's circumstances. Abu Mohammed faces fallout from the hostage debacle.

3.title: FR - Fauda - S03E09 - Episode 9
3.plot: Hila pushes the envelope after the team's operation goes sideways, forcing Eli into a fraught decision. Doron faces a dire choice of his own

3.title: FR - Fauda - S03E10 - Episode 10
3.plot: Rejoined by an old ally, the team leans on Abu Mohammed while preparing for an all-out assault. Bashar discovers a deception and makes a desperate move.

3.title: FR - Fauda - S03E11 - Episode 11
3.plot: Hardened, Bashar resolves to use Doron's own strategy against him. The team mourns a loss. Doron confronts Hila over her heat-of-the-moment decision.

3.title: FR - Fauda - S03E12 - Episode 12
3.plot: Eli sends the team back into the field with a new member, while Bashar's plan for a knockout punch races toward a jolting end.

4.title: FR - Fauda - S04E01 - Episode 1
4.plot: A robbery attempt in Jenin puts Dana on a questionable cell's trail. Gabi asks Doron, still isolated from his old team, to travel with him to Brussels.

4.title: FR - Fauda - S04E02 - Episode 2
4.plot: In the aftermath of a crisis, Eli mobilizes the unit to join Doron in Belgium. Omar's sister Maya and her husband face unexpected questions.

4.title: FR - Fauda - S04E03 - Episode 3
4.plot: The squad presses forward in their search for Gabi, leading to a high-stakes operation in a crowded apartment block. Nurit confesses a secret to Doron.

4.title: FR - Fauda - S04E04 - Episode 4
4.plot: Upon his return, Doron refuses to believe the worst. Maya begins receiving mysterious messages. Dana, hunting for Adel, puts pressure on a new source.

4.title: FR - Fauda - S04E05 - Episode 5
4.plot: In the aftermath of the attacks, Shin Bet mobilizes for revenge while Raphael pitches Doron on a new mission. Sagi reacts to unexpected news.

4.title: FR - Fauda - S04E06 - Episode 6
4.plot: Doron and Maya begin a long journey. The fallout from Sagi's unauthorized plan to lure Adel out of hiding leaves the team divided and at risk.

4.title: FR - Fauda - S04E07 - Episode 7
4.plot: When information leaks to their adversaries in Lebanon, Maya and Doron improvise to reach their destination. Omar faces a painful dilemma.

4.title: FR - Fauda - S04E08 - Episode 8
4.plot: Dana receives a crucial tip that leads Eli's team to a garage in Jenin. Maya finally reaches Aisha, but finds that her mission isn't over yet.

4.title: FR - Fauda - S04E09 - Episode 9
4.plot: A shocking revelation changes the stakes and the plan for Doron. Eli, despite his doubts, signs on for one more mission. Haj moves a valuable asset.

4.title: FR - Fauda - S04E10 - Episode 10
4.plot: Every second counts as the squad, using Omar's intelligence, races to stay ahead of Haj and recover Gabi before his captors move him out of Lebanon.

4.title: FR - Fauda - S04E11 - Episode 11
4.plot: Maya and her family gather in mourning, while Adel moves forward with a plan to strike back. Gabi struggles to process his time as a hostage.

4.title: FR - Fauda - S04E12 - Episode 12
4.plot: Omar's funeral in Jenin provides a morbid opportunity for Shin Bet as they pursue Adel, sending Doron and his teammates into danger once again.

meta.plot: On a college campus, an author navigates a complicated relationship with his daughter.

1.plot: Writer Greg Russo arrives at Ludlow College to support his daughter Katie as her marriage begins to implode.

1.title: EN - Rooster [MULTI-SUB] - S01E02 - Trousers
1.plot: When Katie's future at Ludlow is thrown into question, Walt offers Greg a deal to keep them both on campus.

1.title: EN - Rooster [MULTI-SUB] - S01E04 - Angry, Like An Angry Person
1.plot: To avoid Walt's party, Greg throws himself into helping a student. With her suspension lifted, Katie contemplates casual dating.

1.title: EN - Rooster [MULTI-SUB] - S01E05 - Mr. Razzles
1.plot: When his ex-wife Beth shows up for a dedication ceremony on campus, Greg starts to backslide into old habits. Later, Katie reconnects with Archie, and Dylan finds herself flourishing in her new role.

1.title: EN - Rooster [MULTI-SUB] - S01E06 - Cop Hawk
1.plot: While relishing in his new fling, Greg offers a struggling Tommy a place to crash. Later, Katie confronts the student behind some personal campus graffiti, Dylan impresses Walt in her new role, and Sunny wrestles with a prestigious job offer.

1.title: EN - Rooster [MULTI-SUB] - S01E07 - All the Dogs' Names
1.plot: Greg, Cristle, and Tommy attempt a return to normalcy after an embarrassing mishap. Meanwhile, Archie meets Sunny's father, Walt offers Dylan a new position following Dean Riggs' return, and Katie deals with her evolving feelings for Archie.

1.title: EN - Rooster [MULTI-SUB] - S01E08 - Nobody Spook It
1.plot: While Greg tries to support an increasingly emotional Katie, Dylan attempts to steer a promising student towards poetry. Later, Sunny is delighted when Archie starts to engage more with her

1.title: EN - Rooster [MULTI-SUB] - S01E09 - Ludlow's Fourth Hottest Professor
1.plot: Thriving in and out of the classroom, Greg empowers the hockey team before a key game. Meanwhile, Archie receives feedback on his book and Katie focuses on getting tenure – which reveals the extent of her parents' involvement in her life.

meta.plot: Lorsqu'une professeure de lettres développe une obsession pour un séduisant nouveau collègue, son mariage et sa carrière – déjà compliqués – basculent dans le chaos.

1.plot: As her husband faces scrutiny for his past affairs with students, M finds herself drawn to Vladimir, her captivating — and much younger — new colleague.

1.title: FR - Le Délicieux Professeur V. - S01E02 - The Awakening
1.plot: M resorts to drastic measures to get John's hearing delayed, as cocktails and campus chats deepen her bond with Vlad.

1.title: FR - Le Délicieux Professeur V. - S01E04 - Bad Behavior

1.title: FR - Le Délicieux Professeur V. - S01E05 - Play It as It Lays

1.title: FR - Le Délicieux Professeur V. - S01E08 - Against Interpretation
1.plot: A retreat to the countryside gets complicated as M and Vlad contemplate their writing, their marriages and their wildly uncertain futures.

meta.plot: Barcelona, 2026. During Mobile World Congress week, Ulises Albet, a former tech prodigy turned anti-tech activist, becomes the prime suspect in a murder. As he escapes through a city under lockdown, he uncovers the imminent launch of a groundbreaking technology that could put humanity's ethical future at risk. To stop it, he must confront his past.

1.title: EN - Day One [MULTI-SUB] - S01E01 - Episode 1
1.plot: After years in isolation, Ulises returns to Barcelona when his former partner asks for help decrypting Pandora, the code behind a revolutionary technology. The reunion ends in murder, turning Ulises into the main suspect. As a video of his escape goes viral, tech mogul Damián Diskin prepares to launch Day One, and Ulises realizes that nothing - not even his friend's death - is what it seems.

1.title: EN - Day One [MULTI-SUB] - S01E02 - Episode 2
1.plot: With no trace of Pandora, Ulises turns to Paula, who shows him another video revealing the killer. The only person who can clear him is Rebeca, whose social media activity puts her in Diskin's sights. Determined to protect the launch of Day One, Diskin intervenes through the technology itself, erasing evidence and sending a mercenary to silence all witnesses.

1.title: EN - Day One [MULTI-SUB] - S01E03 - Episode 3
1.plot: Ulises goes into hiding with Rebeca, the only witness who can prove his innocence. Together they discover where Pandora may be hidden, but Rebeca secretly activates the technology, exposing their location. Diskin sends his mercenary to close all loose ends. As violence erupts, Ulises loses everything and is forced to run once again.

1.title: EN - Day One [MULTI-SUB] - S01E04 - Episode 4
1.plot: Rebeca is questioned by the police while Ulises becomes the prime suspect in another murder. When they reunite, they finally access Pandora and uncover its true nature. Unaware that she is being controlled through the contact lenses, Rebeca exposes their location. Biran heads toward their location, as both the police and Diskin close in.

1.title: EN - Day One [MULTI-SUB] - S01E05 - Episode 5
1.plot: Ulises and Rebeca go to the Synchrotron. They need the power of the accelerator to obtain definitive proof that could stop 'Day One'. When they activate the contact lenses to infiltrate the facility, Diskin tracks them. A chase erupts inside the accelerator. Separated and cornered, Ulises escapes outside, where he comes face to face with Inspector Moreno, who aims... and fires.

1.title: EN - Day One [MULTI-SUB] - S01E06 - Episode 6
1.plot: Ulises and Rebeca are taken to Diskin's headquarters under the threat of Inspector Moreno. Meanwhile, Beth considers betraying the magnate and seeks Salvador's help. Diskin reveals the true purpose of the lenses and asks Ulises for his collaboration. As the global launch begins, evidence of the technology's danger breaks into the live broadcast, exposing the truth.

Pendant la semaine du Mobile World Congress, Ulises Albet, ancien prodige de la technologie devenu militant anti-technologie, devient le principal suspect dans une affaire de meurtre. Alors qu'il s'échappe d'une ville bouclée, il découvre le lancement imminent d'une technologie révolutionnaire qui pourrait mettre en péril l'avenir éthique de l'humanité.

As a video of his escape goes viral, tech mogul Damián Diskin prepares to launch Day One, and Ulises realizes that nothing - not even his friend's death - is what it seems.

As violence erupts, Ulises loses everything and is forced to run once again.

When they activate the contact lenses to infiltrate the facility, Diskin tracks them. A chase erupts inside the accelerator. Separated and cornered, Ulises escapes outside, where he comes face to face with Inspector Moreno, who aims... and fires.

meta.plot:
Eric et Ramzy convient 4 de leurs plus grands fans en Espagne sur le tournage de leur nouvelle série : Zorro. Pendant 5 jours, nous les suivons en train de découvrir les coulisses de ce tournage incroyable, mais aussi de s’affronter dans un jeu complètement dingue destiné à répondre à la question suivante : lequel d’entre eux est LE plus grand fan ? À la clé : 20 000€ pour le gagnant. Seul détail : tout est totalement faux, créé de toute pièce pour organiser un gigantesque prank ! Et toutes les personnes impliquées sont des comédiens… Toutes, sauf Boris. Persuadé d’assister à un tournage plus vrai que nature, Boris va vivre la semaine la plus folle de sa vie sous l’oeil de 40 caméras cachées.

Et grâce à la complicité de Laurent Lafitte, Hafid Benamar, Niels Schneider, Youssef Hajdi, Jean-Pascal Zadi, Laura Felpin, Melha Bedia et Marc Labrèche il va se retrouver plongé dans des situations aussi invraisemblables que délirantes !

meta.plot: Ashito Aoi is a young, aspiring soccer player from a backwater town in Japan. His hopes of getting into a high school with a good soccer club are dashed when he causes an incident during a critical match for his team, which results in their loss and elimination from the tournament. Nevertheless, he catches the eye of someone important who happened to be visiting from Tokyo. How will things turn out for Ashito?

1.title: EN - Aoashi [MULTI-SUB] - S01E01 - First touch
1.plot: Aoi Ashito is an ace of a weak soccer team at a junior high school in Ehime. His play almost gets the team to the semi-final in his last tournament in junior high, but provoked by the opponent’s goalie, Ashito receives a red card and is removed from the game. While Ashito is running on the beach to forget the frustration, mysterious Fukuda Tatsuya, who calls himself the manager of Tokyo City Esperion Youth team, approaches Ashito.

1.title: EN - Aoashi [MULTI-SUB] - S01E02 - Tokyo City Esperion

Thoroughly impressed with Esperion’s facility, Ashito is escorted to the tryouts by Hana Ichijo, Fukuda’s sister-in-law. Among the 86 candidates of notable achievements, Ashito has no outstanding records. Nervous as he is, Ashito is excited to be able to play soccer on the beautiful field.

1.title: EN - Aoashi [MULTI-SUB] - S01E03 - The Final Stage of Assessment Begins
1.plot: The final test turns out to be a game with the Esperion Youth team. Fukuda tells the candidates that he will give a piece of information to them during the game. While other candidates feel overwhelmed, Ashito is eager to beat the Youth team so everyone can pass the test. The candidates feel good about the game, but start to feel uneasy at the Youth team's sluggish play.

1.title: EN - Aoashi [MULTI-SUB] - S01E04 - CROW

Unable to recover from the shock, the candidate team allows more goals to the youth team, making it a one-sided match. While his teammates feel completely beaten and lose their fighting spirit, Ashito, still feeling the pain from Akutsu's attack, starts to lose his will to fight.

1.title: EN - Aoashi [MULTI-SUB] - S01E05 - Orange Scenery
1.plot: The letter of acceptance arrives to Ashito in Ehime. Ashito and his friends are overjoyed at the news, but Noriko, Ashito’s mom, looks at the celebration with mixed feelings. Hana tells Ashito to have a heart-to-heart with Noriko, but he never gets the chance until the day of his departure.

1.title: EN - Aoashi [MULTI-SUB] - S01E06 - First Fan
1.plot: Ashito arrives at Esperion's base, meets fellow test participants and meets future teammates. However, the team's coaching staff promises not to give an easy life to the players' desires.

1.title: EN - Aoashi [MULTI-SUB] - S01E07 - The First Youth Match
1.plot: Fukuda suggests that Ashito and other new Esperion Youth players play an intrasquad game. Anyone who proves their worth in the game will be promoted to the A team. All new players are excited at the prospect of joining the A team. Ashito, playing his favorite forward position, starts the game out well. However…

1.title: EN - Aoashi [MULTI-SUB] - S01E08 - Night Training
1.plot: The intrasquad game will determine who gets promoted to the A team. However, no one is passing the ball to Ashito, who is not able to communicate with his teammates through his soccer. He stands in the middle of the field, unable to do anything. Date says that Ashito lacks "individual tactics" to keep up with the constant change of play. Akutsu, a senior player who attacked Ashito at the tryouts, appears in front of him after the game.

1.title: EN - Aoashi [MULTI-SUB] - S01E09 - Spreading Football
1.plot: Ashit who can't easily master the basic soccer movement of "stop and kick". Togashi, who is in the same room, tells the true meaning of "stop and kick", not seeing the thoughtfulness of Ashito who is going to practice alone. However, Togashi's explanation is abstract, and night training is difficult. They both irritated each other, but eventually, from the movement of Togashi, Ashito finally got a hint of "stop and kick".

1.title: EN - Aoashi [MULTI-SUB] - S01E10 - No Compromises
1.plot: In the unusual mini game of 11-on-21, Ashito completely loses the trust of Kuroda and Asari for lack of cooperation. Date gives Ashito the assignment to figure out why they got mad at him. While the others enjoy the only day off of the week, Ashito sets out to practice alone, not being able to find the answer. Then, a sudden visitor appears.

1.title: EN - Aoashi [MULTI-SUB] - S01E11 - Tokyo Metropolis League Match 1 - Seikyo High School
1.plot: Tokyo Metropolis League has opened. Ashito and others have their first official match against Seikyo High, but the mood of the team has been awful since the fight on the day of the entrance ceremony. The Esperion Youth B team struggles to coordinate, despite being chosen as a starter, Ashito hasn't found the answer to Date's assignment. Frustrated, Taira suggests that the first-year players switched out.

1.title: EN - Aoashi [MULTI-SUB] - S01E12 - Eagle Eye
1.plot: In the second half of Tokyo Metropolis League Match 1 against Seikyo High School, Ashito coordinates with Kuroda and Asari, and learns the importance of carrying the ball with three players. Having the answer to his assignment, Ashito initiates the counterattacks of the Esperion B team. As they make a comeback from the disadvantage of 0 -3, the game time is running out. In his extreme state of concentration, something strange is happening to Ashito's eyes…!

1.title: EN - Aoashi [MULTI-SUB] - S01E13 - Turn
1.plot: During the celebration dinner for the victorious match against Seikyo High, a soccer game comes on the TV at the BBQ restaurant, showing Kuribayashi making his J1 debut. Around the time Kuribayashi finishes his interview for his incredible play, Mibu receives a call from Date, telling him that there will be some member change between the A team and the B team, since Yoshitsune injured himself. Ashito makes some great plays at the promotion game. Will Ashito be able to move up to the A team?

1.title: EN - Aoashi [MULTI-SUB] - S01E14 - It's Just Soccer
1.plot: Fukuda tells Ashito to change position to defender, which was not something Ashito could stomach. His teammates, wondering why Ashito didn't show up to the announcement of the A team promotion, learn the truth and feel shocked. Tachibana, Ohtomo, Togashi, Kuroda, and Asari go and look for Ashito, but he's nowhere to be found. It is Hana, who walks up to Ashito, sitting at a bus stop all by himself.

1.title: EN - Aoashi [MULTI-SUB] - S01E15 - Where I Ought to Be
1.plot: While still feeling unconvinced, Ashito makes up his mind that he must try and learn to be a full-back. He goes to practice, wanting to figure out Fukuda's intention. However, being unfamiliar to the position and disliking defending, Ashito doesn't quite get the meaning of "shuffle" and feels out of place.

1.title: EN - Aoashi [MULTI-SUB] - S01E16 - Just Like You
1.plot: Advised by Takeshima and Anri that he should study Kuribayashi's movements, Ashito pours over the broadcast of the J1 match to see Kuribayashi's play. Combing over the past footage of Kuribayashi's play, Ashito realizes that what set Kuribayashi apart is how he turns his head. Ashito tries to incorporate it in his practice right away, but it only confuses him. In his teammates eyes, that confusion looks like being unmotivated for having to play a full-back.

1.title: EN - Aoashi [MULTI-SUB] - S01E17 - Tokyo Metropolis League Match 7 - Tama Sports Science University High School
1.plot: Ashito and others have an unexpected reunion with Nakano and Kaneda, who played alongside him at the tryouts. After failing the tryouts for Esperion, Nakano and Kaneda joined the current top team in the league, Tokyo Musashino Soccer Club Youth, where Tachibana used to play. While Nakano is happy to see Ashito and others, Kaneda blames Ashito for his failing the tryouts.

1.title: EN - Aoashi [MULTI-SUB] - S01E18 - Wind of Change
1.plot: Esperion B team has a match against Tama Sports University. Thanks to Yoshitsune, they finish the first half with one goal lead. However, Togashi and Takeshima mess up their play at the beginning of the second half and allow the opponent a goal. With Isshiki out of the game due to his injury, the B team changes the formation, and Togashi and Ashito are instructed to move upfield. Date tells Ashito to take what he learned defending and apply it to attacking.

1.title: EN - Aoashi [MULTI-SUB] - S01E19 - What We Lack
1.plot: The B team ends the match with Tama Sports U. Next match is against Musashino, currently the first place of the League and also Tachibana's old team. However, Tachibana doesn't feel confident enough to play since he hasn't had notable achievements in the League so far, and asks Date not to play him in the match against Musashino. Ashito and others bring Tachibana along to observe Musashino's game. Team Musashino, which includes Kaneda and Nakano, who played alongside Ashito at the tryouts, displays an incredible play.

1.title: EN - Aoashi [MULTI-SUB] - S01E20 - The Truly Weak One
1.plot: Esperion B team starts to show some signs of improvement as they face undefeated Musashino in the next match. When the team needs to be united more than ever, Takeshima and Togashi, who are the key defenders of the team, have a huge fight. Tachibana, with a strong resolution that he will do anything he can to win the next match, goes to Yuma to ask him what happened between Togashi and the promoted players in the past.

1.title: EN - Aoashi [MULTI-SUB] - S01E21 - Tokyo Metropolis League Match 8 - Tokyo Musashino FC Youth
1.plot: The game against Tokyo Musashino is the climax of the Tokyo Metropolis League for Esperion B team. Although the team has worked on countermeasures against Musashino, the air is still tense within the team and there's a clear sign of anxiety on the faces of many of them during the warmup. But right before the game starts, Takeshima disappears from the locker room with his girlfriend, Tae.

1.title: EN - Aoashi [MULTI-SUB] - S01E22 - Like a Demon
1.plot: Esperion B team bitterly allows the first goal to Muto, the playmaker of Musashino. With Musashino one step ahead, second-year Sugawara suggests that they go back to their original play style that relies on short passes. But Tachibana, Togashi, and Takeshima insist on continuing with the direct approach they've been practicing. To the disconcerted players, Date starts giving concrete instructions for a change.

1.title: EN - Aoashi [MULTI-SUB] - S01E23 - Do Your Best. Don't Lose. Fight to Your Limits
1.plot: The match between Esperion and Musashino will determine who will dominate the Tokyo Metropolis League. Musashino's ace, Kaneda, takes advantage of the weak coordination between Togashi and Takeshima, giving Musashino a go-ahead score. Right before the end of first half, Kuroda injures himself due to his desperate defense play. During the halftime, Asari blames the center-backs, but Date disagrees with him. Togashi has resented Takeshima for a long time, but now…

1.title: EN - Aoashi [MULTI-SUB] - S01E24 - From Now
1.plot: Thanks to Ashito's great bird's-eye view, Esperion B team succeeds in bringing down the defense of Musashino and scores a tie-goal. Esperion gains the momentum, while Musashino is confused by Ashito's flexible play. Kaneda can't hide his frustration at seeing just how much Ashito has improved. The desperate battle between the top of the Tokyo Metropolitan League, Musashino, and the challenger, Esperion: Who will win in the end...?

A diverse group of tourists on an organized trip to Lisbon find themselves investigating a murder after one of them is killed on the first morning.

1.title: EN - If It's Tuesday... It's Murder [MULTI-SUB] - S01E01 - Episode 1
1.plot: MONDAY. The bus hasn’t even started moving, and we can already sense that something is off. From the moment they arrive in Lisbon, things begin to go wrong, and they end up in a rundown, crumbling hotel. The next morning, on TUESDAY, they find Fernando lying dead in his room, a missing music box, and a long investigation begins.

1.title: EN - If It's Tuesday... It's Murder [MULTI-SUB] - S01E02 - Episode 2
1.plot: WEDNESDAY. The police tags the case a natural death. Daniel, obsessed with the clues that keep emerging, pushes Inspector Gonçalo and the police to their limits. Alicia follows Fabio, but at the center of it all is the deceased Fernando and along the way come a strange explosion, a thief attempting to steal the music box, a new death, make the trip a complete nightmare.

1.title: EN - If It's Tuesday... It's Murder [MULTI-SUB] - S01E03 - Episode 3
1.plot: THURSDAY. Our four investigators are one step ahead of the police, and as they piece together Fernando’s story, they begin to draw connections between key historical moments in Lisbon and everything happening around them. The city’s history seems to speak to them and the puzzle starts falling into place. The existence of an ancient treasure appears to be the key.

1.title: EN - If It's Tuesday... It's Murder [MULTI-SUB] - S01E04 - Episode 4
1.plot: FRIDAY. Our four investigators uncover new clues all pointing to a suspect: Nicolau. Pura and Alicia follow him closely. Daniel, the cleverest of the group, continues investigating the treasure. He deciphers that the Cross of Portugal is a key element, but incredibly, Nicolau gets ahead of him. Another crime, the police once again at the Hotel Marqués, and all the tourists become suspects again.

1.title: EN - If It's Tuesday... It's Murder [MULTI-SUB] - S01E05 - Episode 5
1.plot: SATURDAY. The trip has already turned tragic, three people dead, several suspects, and the Portuguese police stationed at the Hotel Marqués in search of answers. Just when tempers begin to settle, Daniel and Pilar come face to face with danger, and in this atmosphere, chaos takes over the group. Everyone’s a suspect in everyone else’s eyes. Daniel risks everything to solve the mystery.

1.title: EN - If It's Tuesday... It's Murder [MULTI-SUB] - S01E06 - Episode 6
1.plot: SUNDAY. Daniel is still missing, and everyone is going around the city looking for him. But Alicia, Pura and Fabio must confront their secrets and their past; some of which will even find their way to Lisbon. Confusion and fear intensify when Inspector Gonçalo announces who he believes is responsible for Nicolau’s murder. Pura, fluent in Portuguese, discovers the key to everything.

1.title: EN - If It's Tuesday... It's Murder [MULTI-SUB] - S01E07 - Episode 7
1.plot: MONDAY. The trip comes to an end, and our investigators unveil their case in grand fashion, on a theater stage. Daniel returns and becomes the star. The pasts of Fernando, Inspector Gonçalo, the Marquis of Pombal, and the treasure of the music box trigger a new earthquake reminiscent of 1755. The rest of Lisbon is fine, but the theater trembles as our investigators finally reveal the mystery.

1.plot: Satou reaches the top of the Cradle, but he won't be able to take Mia back before confronting a final challenge... One that will end with a surprising addition to his entourage.

1.title: FR - Death March to the Parallel World Rhapsody - S01E10 - The Hunting Song That Started with a Death March
1.plot: The journey to return Mia home begins, giving Satou a chance to experiment with the functionality of the fantasy world during the long trip.

1.title: FR - Death March to the Parallel World Rhapsody - S01E11 - The Fantasy Conspiracy That Started with a Death March
1.plot: The journey to take Mia home continues, with Satou running afoul the local nobles by disrupting their scheme involving the distribution of healing potions.

1.title: FR - Death March to the Parallel World Rhapsody - S01E12 - A Trip to the Underworld That Started with a Death March
1.plot: Satou has to deliver on an arrangement where countless factors have been twisted against him, but will that be enough to keep him from pulling through?

Comme il connaît bien toutes les fonctions et les recoins du jeu, il se révèle très à l'aise dans ce monde. Cependant, il préfère rester discret à ce sujet et tandis qu’il part à sa découverte, il tente de venir en aide aux différents personnages qu’il croise.
Bound by a deity's pact, Han Chieh fights demons on Earth. When he uncovers an old enemy's plan for a second invasion, he must fight to save humanity.

1.plot: Yeh Tzu tags along on another case and proves helpful. Han Chieh realises that an old enemy is back.

1.plot: When a neighbor goes missing, Han Chieh takes a trip to find out what's going on. He uncovers something much more sinister and decides to take action.

1.title: EN - Agent from Above [MULTI-SUB] - S01E04 - The Ghost Forge
1.plot: More disappearances linked to the Demon King occur. Han Chieh confronts an old enemy, only to unearth a larger, looming evil.

1.title: EN - Agent from Above [MULTI-SUB] - S01E05 - Into the Abyss
1.plot: Recovering from battle, Han Chieh follows a message to a key location, leading him and Chang-min to surprising new leads in their hunt for answers.

1.plot: As they close in on the new troublemaker in town, a lucky amulet causes some stir, so Han Chieh and Chang-min investigate its dark origins.

1.title: EN - Agent from Above [MULTI-SUB] - S01E07 - The Descent
1.plot: Yeh Tzu brings Han Chieh to a special spot to reflect before battle. Later, he faces a tough decision involving a huge sacrifice.

1.title: EN - Agent from Above [MULTI-SUB] - S01E08 - Turning the Wheel
1.plot: Chaos reigns under the full moon at Dongfeng Market. Han Chieh must rally all his allies to face pure evil, protect loved ones and save the world.

meta.plot: Spanning from the desert to the city, this offbeat comedy anthology tells unique tales of desire, ambition… and those tempted enough to seek them out.

1.title: EN - Alkhallat+: The Series [MULTI-SUB] - S01E01 - Desert Rules

meta.plot: From thugs to yakuza, Taiza Kujo wields the law to defend society's worst. Fellow lawyer, Karasuma doubts his ethics but joins him in facing the abyss.

1.title: EN - Sins of Kujo [MULTI-SUB] - S01E01 - The Worth of a Leg
1.plot: At Kujo Law Office, an eccentric attorney takes on a hit-and-run case as a favor to gang leader Mibu — raising questions from his curious new partner.

1.title: EN - Sins of Kujo [MULTI-SUB] - S01E02 - The Dignity of the Vulnerable

1.plot: Sogabe makes a firm decision to break his situation — and goes to prison. After a run-in with his estranged brother, Kujo meets with a suspicious CEO.

1.plot: A disturbing case of fraud and coercion at a nursing home leads Kujo to confront his former mentor, Yamashiro, in a bid to stop his reckless actions.

1.title: EN - Sins of Kujo [MULTI-SUB] - S01E05 - Family Ties 2
1.plot: Kujo takes on a new request where a past conflict between Mibu and his boss Kyogoku, the young leader of the Kyogoku gang, comes to light.

1.title: EN - Sins of Kujo [MULTI-SUB] - S01E06 - Remnants of Consumption
1.plot: Kujo agrees to defend Kyogoku's associate in a case fronted by his former classmate. Meanwhile, a troubled girl tries to enter the adult video industry.

1.title: EN - Sins of Kujo [MULTI-SUB] - S01E07 - Remnants of Consumption 2
1.plot: After her parents' selfish actions, Shizuku turns to Shuto for support but instead finds more manipulation, pushing her to the edge as tragedy strikes.

1.plot: Karasuma presses Mibu about his connection to Detective Arashiyama's case and goes out of his way to protect Kujo from any further involvement.

1.plot: Karasuma and Kujo contemplate their partnership as their future hangs in the balance. Inukai's actions draw Mibu and Kyogoku into a risky situation.
